title: My Morning Routine
situation_ko: 친구가 당신의 아침 일과를 궁금해해요.

questions.q: What time do you wake up?
questions.sample: I wake up at seven.

questions.q: Oh, I see. What do you do first in the morning?
questions.q_ko: 아, 그렇군요. 아침에 제일 먼저 뭘 해요?
questions.sample: I wash my face first.

questions.q: Nice! Do you eat breakfast?
questions.sample: Yes, I eat toast and drink coffee.

questions.q: Got it. What time do you leave home?
questions.sample: I leave home at eight.

questions.q: Do you like mornings?
questions.sample: Not really. I am sleepy in the morning.

closing: Thanks for sharing! Have a great morning tomorrow.
closing_ko: 이야기해 줘서 고마워요! 내일 아침도 좋은 하루 보내요.

title: What's for Breakfast
situation_ko: 룸메이트가 아침으로 뭘 먹을지 물어봐요.

questions.q: Good morning! Are you hungry?
questions.sample: Yes, a little.

questions.q: Great. What do you want for breakfast?
questions.sample: I want some eggs and bread.

questions.q: Sounds good! Do you want coffee or tea?
questions.sample: Coffee, please.

questions.q: Okay. Do you usually eat rice or bread?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 보통 밥을 먹어요, 빵을 먹어요?
questions.sample: I usually eat rice.

questions.q: What is your favorite breakfast?
questions.sample: I like pancakes with fruit.

closing: Yum! Let's eat together soon.
closing_ko: 맛있겠다! 곧 같이 먹어요.

title: Meeting a New Neighbor
situation_ko: 엘리베이터에서 새 이웃을 만났어요.

key_phrases.text: I live on the fifth floor.
Let me know if you need help.

questions.q: Hi! I just moved in. What's your name?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 이제 막 이사 왔어요. 이름이 뭐예요?
questions.sample: My name is Minho. Nice to meet you.

questions.q: Nice to meet you too! Which floor do you live on?
questions.sample: I live on the fifth floor.

questions.q: Oh, great. Do you like this building?
questions.q_ko: 아, 좋네요. 이 건물 마음에 들어요?
questions.sample: Yes, it is quiet and clean.

questions.q: Good to know. Is there a store near here?
questions.sample: Yes, there is a small market next door.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 바로 옆에 작은 마트가 있어요.

questions.q: Thanks! Do you live here with your family?
questions.sample: No, I live alone.

closing: It was nice talking to you. See you around!
closing_ko: 이야기해서 즐거웠어요. 또 봐요!

title: How's the Weather
situation_ko: 버스 정류장에서 옆 사람과 날씨 이야기를 해요.
ai_role: Tom, a stranger at the bus stop

questions.q: Hello! How is the weather today?
questions.sample: It's sunny and warm.

questions.q: Yes, it is nice. Do you like this weather?
questions.sample: Yes, I like sunny days.

questions.q: Me too! What is your favorite season?
questions.sample: I like spring.

questions.q: Spring is lovely. Do you like rainy days?
questions.q_ko: 봄은 참 좋죠. 비 오는 날은 좋아해요?
questions.sample: Not really. I don't like getting wet.

questions.q: I understand. What do you wear when it is cold?
questions.sample: I wear a warm coat.

closing: Oh, my bus is here. Nice chatting with you!
closing_ko: 아, 제 버스가 왔네요. 얘기해서 좋았어요!

title: My Dog
situation_ko: 공원에서 이웃이 당신의 강아지에 대해 물어봐요.
ai_role: Sara, a neighbor in the park

questions.q: What a cute dog! What is his name?
questions.sample: His name is Coco.

questions.q: Coco is a great name! How old is he?
questions.q_ko: 코코 정말 좋은 이름이에요! 몇 살이에요?
questions.sample: He is two years old.

questions.q: Aw, he's still young. What does he like to eat?
questions.q_ko: 아, 아직 어리네요. 뭘 먹는 걸 좋아해요?
questions.sample: He likes chicken snacks.

questions.q: Funny! How often do you walk him?
questions.sample: We walk every morning and evening.

questions.q: That's good for him. Is he friendly with people?
questions.sample: Yes, he loves everyone.

closing: He is so sweet. Enjoy your walk!
closing_ko: 정말 사랑스러워요. 즐거운 산책 되세요!

title: Laundry Day
situation_ko: 가족이 빨래에 대해 물어봐요.

key_phrases.text: I hang the clothes to dry.

questions.q: Hi, honey. Do you do your own laundry?
questions.sample: Yes, I do it myself.

questions.q: Good job. Which day do you do laundry?
questions.sample: I do laundry on Sunday.

questions.q: I see. Do you use a dryer or hang your clothes?
questions.q_ko: 그렇구나. 건조기를 쓰니, 아니면 널어서 말리니?
questions.sample: I hang my clothes near the window.

questions.q: Smart. Do you iron your shirts?
questions.sample: No, I don't. I don't like ironing.

questions.q: Ha ha. Do you need anything from home?
questions.sample: Yes, I need some soap.

closing: Okay, I'll send it. Take care, sweetheart!
closing_ko: 알았어, 보내 줄게. 몸 조심하렴!

title: Taking Out the Trash
situation_ko: 아파트 경비원이 쓰레기 버리는 법을 물어봐요.
ai_role: Mr. Lee, the apartment security guard

key_phrases.text: I take it out at night.
Where do I put the cans?

questions.q: Hello! Do you have trash today?
questions.sample: Yes, I have one bag.

questions.q: Okay. When do you usually take out the trash?
questions.sample: I take it out at night.

questions.q: I see. Do you have food waste too?
questions.sample: Yes, I have a little.

questions.q: Please use the brown bin for that. Do you have any plastic or cans?
questions.q_ko: 그건 갈색 통에 버리세요. 플라스틱이나 캔도 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I have two bottles.

questions.q: Good. Is the bin place easy to find?
questions.sample: Yes, it is near the entrance.

closing: Thank you for sorting your trash. Good night!
closing_ko: 분리수거해 주셔서 감사해요. 안녕히 주무세요!

title: Taking the Bus
situation_ko: 동료가 어떻게 출근하는지 물어봐요.

questions.q: Good morning! How do you come to work?
questions.sample: I take the bus.

questions.q: Oh, nice. How long does it take?
questions.sample: It takes thirty minutes.

questions.q: That's not bad. Is the bus crowded?
questions.sample: Yes, it is very crowded in the morning.

questions.q: Oh no. What do you do on the bus?
questions.sample: I listen to music.

questions.q: Sounds relaxing. What time do you get home?
questions.sample: I get home at seven.

closing: Thanks! Let's have lunch together today.
closing_ko: 고마워요! 오늘 점심 같이 먹어요.

title: Weekend Plans
situation_ko: 친구가 이번 주말에 뭐 할 건지 물어봐요.

key_phrases.text: I want to see a movie.
Do you want to join me?

questions.q: Hey! Do you have any plans this weekend?
questions.sample: Yes, I want to see a movie.

questions.q: Fun! Who are you going with?
questions.sample: I'm going with my sister.

questions.q: Nice. What kind of movie do you like?
questions.sample: I like comedy movies.

questions.q: Cool. What will you do on Sunday?
questions.sample: I'm going to stay home and rest.

questions.q: Sounds nice. Do you like weekends?
questions.sample: Yes, I love weekends.

closing: Have a lovely weekend! Tell me about it on Monday.
closing_ko: 즐거운 주말 보내요! 월요일에 얘기해 줘요.

title: Family Dinner
situation_ko: 가족과 함께 저녁 식사를 하며 이야기해요.

questions.q: Dinner is ready! Are you hungry?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm very hungry.

questions.q: Good. How is the soup?
questions.sample: It's delicious.

questions.q: I'm glad. Do you want more rice?
questions.sample: Yes, a little more, please.

questions.q: Here you go. How was your day?
questions.sample: It was good. I was busy at work.

questions.q: I see. Who is going to wash the dishes?
questions.sample: I'll wash the dishes.

closing: Thank you, son. You are a good helper!
closing_ko: 고맙다. 넌 정말 잘 도와주는구나!

title: Your Birthday
situation_ko: 동료가 곧 다가오는 당신의 생일에 대해 물어봐요.

key_phrases.text: I'll have dinner with my family.

questions.q: I heard your birthday is soon. When is it?
questions.sample: My birthday is in May.

questions.q: Oh, happy early birthday! What will you do that day?
questions.q_ko: 아, 미리 생일 축하해요! 그날 뭐 할 거예요?
questions.sample: I'll have dinner with my family.

questions.q: Lovely. What kind of cake do you like?
questions.sample: I love chocolate cake.

questions.q: Yum! What gift would you like?
questions.sample: I'd like a new book.

questions.q: Good idea. Do you sing the birthday song in your family?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 가족끼리 생일 노래를 불러요?
questions.sample: Yes, we always sing it.

closing: I hope you have a wonderful birthday!
closing_ko: 멋진 생일 보내길 바랄게요!

title: At the Post Office
situation_ko: 우체국에서 소포를 보내려고 해요.

key_phrases.text: I want to send this box.

questions.q: Hello. How can I help you?
questions.sample: I want to send this box.

questions.q: Sure. Where is it going?
questions.sample: It's going to Busan.

questions.q: Okay. What is in the box?
questions.sample: There are some clothes.

questions.q: Got it. Do you want regular or fast delivery?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 일반 배송으로 할까요, 빠른 배송으로 할까요?
questions.sample: Regular delivery, please.

questions.q: Fine. Do you need anything else, like stamps?
questions.q_ko: 좋습니다. 우표 같은 다른 필요한 건 없으세요?
questions.sample: No, that's all. How much is it?

closing: It will arrive in two days. Have a nice day!
closing_ko: 이틀 뒤에 도착할 거예요. 좋은 하루 보내세요!

title: A Package at the Door
situation_ko: 택배 기사님이 문 앞에서 택배를 전달해요.

questions.q: Hello! Is this your apartment?
questions.sample: Yes, this is my apartment.

questions.q: Great. Can you tell me your name, please?
questions.sample: My name is Jisu Kim.

questions.q: Thank you. Did you order something online?
questions.sample: Yes, I ordered some shoes.

questions.q: Here they are. Do you want me to carry the box inside?
questions.q_ko: 여기 있어요. 상자를 안으로 옮겨 드릴까요?
questions.sample: No, please leave it here.

questions.q: Sure. Will someone be home tomorrow?
questions.sample: Yes, I will be home all day.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 제가 하루 종일 집에 있어요.

closing: Have a nice day, and enjoy your shoes!
closing_ko: 좋은 하루 보내시고 신발 잘 신으세요!

title: Grocery List
situation_ko: 룸메이트와 함께 장 볼 목록을 정해요.

questions.q: The fridge is almost empty. What do we need?
questions.sample: We need milk and eggs.

questions.q: Right. Do we need any vegetables?
questions.sample: Yes, we need onions and carrots.

questions.q: Okay. What fruit do you like?
questions.sample: I like apples and bananas.

questions.q: Good choices. Where do you want to shop?
questions.sample: Let's go to the big market.

questions.q: Sure. When should we go?
questions.sample: Let's go on Saturday morning.

closing: Great, it's a plan. I'll make the list.
closing_ko: 좋아요, 그렇게 해요. 제가 목록을 만들게요.

title: Before Bed
situation_ko: 룸메이트가 잠자기 전 습관을 물어봐요.

key_phrases.text: I go to bed at eleven.

questions.q: It's late! What time do you go to bed?
questions.sample: I go to bed at eleven.

questions.q: Okay. What do you do before bed?
questions.sample: I brush my teeth and read a book.

questions.q: Nice habit. Do you use your phone in bed?
questions.sample: Yes, a little.

questions.q: Me too, sometimes. Do you sleep well?
questions.q_ko: 저도 가끔 그래요. 잠은 잘 자요?
questions.sample: Yes, I sleep well.

questions.q: Great. What time do you set your alarm?
questions.sample: I set it for six thirty.

closing: Okay, good night. Sleep well!
closing_ko: 그럼 잘 자요. 푹 자요!

title: Moving to a New Place
situation_ko: 이사 업체 직원이 이사 계획을 확인해요.

key_phrases.text: I have a lot of boxes.
Please be careful with the TV.

questions.q: Hello! When are you planning to move?
questions.sample: I'm moving on the twentieth of this month.

questions.q: Got it. How big is your current apartment?
questions.q_ko: 알겠습니다. 지금 사는 집은 얼마나 큰가요?
questions.sample: It's a small two-room apartment.

questions.q: Okay. Do you have any large items, like a sofa or a piano?
questions.q_ko: 네. 소파나 피아노 같은 큰 물건이 있나요?
questions.sample: I have a big sofa and a bed.

questions.q: Thanks. Is there an elevator in your new building?
questions.sample: Yes, there is, so it should be easy.

questions.q: Perfect. Is there anything fragile we should be careful with?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 특별히 조심해야 할 깨지기 쉬운 물건이 있나요?
questions.sample: Yes, please be careful with my TV and the plates.

closing: No problem. We'll send you the price by message today.
closing_ko: 문제없어요. 오늘 메시지로 가격을 보내 드릴게요.

title: Opening a Bank Account
situation_ko: 은행에서 새 계좌를 만들려고 해요.

key_phrases.text: I'd like to open an account.
I have my ID with me.
Can I use it on my phone?

questions.q: Welcome to the bank. What can I do for you today?
questions.q_ko: 은행에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 오늘 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
questions.sample: I'd like to open a savings account.

questions.q: Of course. Do you have your ID with you?
questions.sample: Yes, I have my ID card here.

questions.q: Thank you. Why do you want a savings account?
questions.q_ko: 감사합니다. 저축 계좌를 만들려는 이유가 뭔가요?
questions.sample: I want to save money for a trip next year.
questions.sample_ko: 내년 여행을 위해 돈을 모으고 싶어요.

questions.q: That's a good goal. How much do you plan to save each month?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 목표네요. 매달 얼마나 저축할 계획인가요?
questions.sample: I plan to save about three hundred thousand won.
questions.sample_ko: 한 달에 30만 원 정도 모을 계획이에요.

questions.q: Great. Would you like to use mobile banking too?
questions.sample: Yes, I'd like that. Can you help me set it up?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 쓰고 싶어요. 설정을 도와주실 수 있나요?

closing: Certainly. Please wait a moment while I prepare the papers.
closing_ko: 물론이죠. 서류를 준비하는 동안 잠시 기다려 주세요.

title: A Leak in the Ceiling
situation_ko: 천장에서 물이 새서 집주인에게 전화해요.

key_phrases.text: Water is coming from the ceiling.

key_phrases.ko: 오늘 누가 와 줄 수 있나요?

questions.q: Hello, this is Mr. Choi. What's the problem?
questions.sample: Hello. Water is coming from the ceiling in my bathroom.

questions.q: Oh no. When did it start?
questions.sample: It started last night around ten.

questions.q: I see. Is it a lot of water, or just a few drops?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 물이 많이 나오나요, 아니면 몇 방울인가요?
questions.sample: It's not a lot, but the floor is wet.

questions.q: Okay. Did you put anything under it?
questions.sample: Yes, I put a bucket under it.

questions.q: Good idea. When will you be home so a repairman can come?
questions.q_ko: 잘하셨어요. 수리 기사가 올 수 있게 언제 집에 계세요?
questions.sample: I'll be home after six this evening.

closing: I'll call a repairman right now. Thanks for telling me.
closing_ko: 지금 바로 수리 기사를 부를게요. 알려 줘서 고마워요.

title: Sorting Recycling
situation_ko: 관리사무소 직원이 분리수거 방법을 안내해요.

key_phrases.text: I'm not sure where this goes.
Do I need to wash it first?

questions.q: Hi there. Do you know how recycling works in our building?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요. 우리 건물 분리수거 방법을 아세요?
questions.sample: I know a little, but I'm not sure about everything.

questions.q: No worries. What do you usually throw away?
questions.sample: Mostly plastic bottles, cans, and paper boxes.

questions.q: Those go in separate bins. Do you wash the bottles first?
questions.q_ko: 그건 각각 다른 통에 넣어요. 병은 먼저 씻으세요?
questions.sample: Sometimes I forget. Do I need to wash them?

questions.q: Yes, a quick rinse helps. And what about food waste?
questions.q_ko: 네, 간단히 헹구면 좋아요. 음식물 쓰레기는 어떻게 하세요?
questions.sample: I put it in a special bag and take it to the food bin.
questions.sample_ko: 전용 봉투에 담아서 음식물 통에 버려요.

questions.q: Perfect. Do you have a question about anything else?
questions.sample: Yes, what day can I throw away big furniture?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 큰 가구는 무슨 요일에 버릴 수 있나요?

closing: Big items need a sticker. I'll show you where to get one.
closing_ko: 큰 물건은 스티커가 필요해요. 어디서 사는지 알려 드릴게요.

title: Subway Delay
situation_ko: 지하철이 지연되어 직장 동료와 통화해요.

key_phrases.text: I'll be about twenty minutes late.

questions.q: Hi, are you on your way? The meeting starts soon.
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요, 오는 중이에요? 회의가 곧 시작해요.
questions.sample: I'm on the subway, but it's delayed.

questions.q: Oh no. What happened?
questions.sample: I think there's a problem with the signal.

questions.q: I see. How late will you be?
questions.sample: I'll be about twenty minutes late.

questions.q: Okay. Do you want me to tell the boss?
questions.sample: Yes, please. Thank you so much.

questions.q: Sure. Is there something you want me to prepare for you?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요. 제가 대신 준비해 둘 게 있어요?
questions.sample: Could you print the report for me?

closing: No problem. Be careful and see you soon!
closing_ko: 문제없어요. 조심해서 오고, 곧 봐요!

title: Noisy Neighbor
situation_ko: 위층 이웃에게 소음에 대해 정중하게 이야기해요.

key_phrases.ko: 조금 조용히 걸어 주실 수 있을까요?

questions.q: Oh, hello. Is something wrong?
questions.sample: Hello. Sorry to bother you. I live downstairs.
questions.sample_ko: 안녕하세요. 귀찮게 해서 죄송해요. 저는 아래층에 살아요.

questions.q: Nice to meet you. What can I do for you?
questions.sample: I sometimes hear loud footsteps at night.

questions.q: Oh, I'm sorry. What time do you usually hear it?
questions.q_ko: 아, 죄송해요. 보통 몇 시쯤 들리세요?
questions.sample: Usually around eleven or twelve.

questions.q: I see. My kids play before bed. How does it affect you?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 아이들이 자기 전에 놀아서요. 어떤 점이 불편하세요?
questions.sample: It's hard for me to fall asleep.

questions.q: I understand. What would you like us to do?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 저희가 어떻게 해 드리면 좋을까요?
questions.sample: Could you put a carpet on the floor?
questions.sample_ko: 바닥에 카펫을 깔아 주실 수 있을까요?

closing: Of course. We'll be more careful. Thank you for telling me kindly.
closing_ko: 물론이죠. 더 조심할게요. 친절하게 말해 줘서 고마워요.

title: Taking Your Cat to the Vet
situation_ko: 고양이가 아파서 동물병원에 갔어요.

questions.q: Hello. What's your cat's name, and how old is she?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요. 고양이 이름이랑 나이가 어떻게 되나요?
questions.sample: Her name is Nabi, and she is three years old.

questions.q: Thanks. What seems to be the problem?
questions.sample: She hasn't eaten since yesterday.

questions.q: I see. Is she drinking water?
questions.sample: Yes, but only a little.

questions.q: Okay. Has she eaten anything unusual lately?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 최근에 평소와 다른 걸 먹었나요?
questions.sample: I don't think so, but she played with a plastic bag.
questions.sample_ko: 그런 것 같진 않은데 비닐봉지를 가지고 놀았어요.

questions.q: Hmm. Do you have any other questions for me?
questions.q_ko: 음. 저에게 다른 궁금한 점이 있으세요?
questions.sample: Is it serious? Does she need medicine?

closing: Let me check her first. Please don't worry too much.
closing_ko: 먼저 진찰해 볼게요. 너무 걱정하지 마세요.

title: Holiday Plans
situation_ko: 동료가 곧 다가오는 명절에 뭘 할지 물어봐요.

questions.q: The holiday is almost here! What are your plans?
questions.sample: I'm going to my hometown to see my parents.

questions.q: That's nice. How will you get there?
questions.sample: I'll take the train because the traffic is terrible.
questions.sample_ko: 차가 너무 막혀서 기차를 탈 거예요.

questions.q: Smart. What do you usually do with your family?
questions.sample: We make food together and talk a lot.
questions.sample_ko: 같이 음식을 만들고 이야기를 많이 해요.

questions.q: Sounds warm. What's your favorite holiday food?
questions.q_ko: 따뜻하겠어요. 명절 음식 중에 제일 좋아하는 게 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I love the rice cakes and the pancakes.

questions.q: Yum! Is there anything you don't like about holidays?
questions.sample: Well, I get tired of the long trip.
questions.sample_ko: 음, 먼 길을 가는 게 지쳐요.

closing: Have a safe trip and a happy holiday!
closing_ko: 안전하게 다녀오고 즐거운 명절 보내요!

title: Weekend Cleaning
situation_ko: 가족과 함께 주말 집안일을 나눠요.

questions.q: The house is a mess! Which chore do you hate the most?
questions.q_ko: 집이 엉망이에요! 어떤 집안일이 제일 싫어요?
questions.sample: I hate washing the dishes the most.

questions.q: Ha, me too. So which chore do you want to do today?
questions.q_ko: 하하, 저도요. 그럼 오늘은 어떤 걸 하고 싶어요?
questions.sample: I'll vacuum the living room.

questions.q: Great. I'll do the bathroom. Do we have enough cleaning supplies?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 저는 화장실을 할게요. 청소 용품은 충분해요?
questions.sample: I think we need more bathroom cleaner.
questions.sample_ko: 화장실 세제가 더 필요한 것 같아요.

questions.q: I'll buy some later. How long do you think this will take?
questions.q_ko: 나중에 제가 사 올게요. 얼마나 걸릴 것 같아요?
questions.sample: Maybe two hours if we work together.
questions.sample_ko: 같이 하면 두 시간쯤 걸릴 것 같아요.

questions.q: Okay. What shall we do after we finish?
questions.sample: Let's order pizza and watch a movie.

closing: Deal! Let's get started so we can relax later.
closing_ko: 좋아요! 나중에 쉴 수 있게 시작해요.

title: Missing Package
situation_ko: 배송 완료로 뜨는데 택배가 없어서 고객센터에 전화해요.

key_phrases.text: It says delivered, but I didn't get it.

questions.q: Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
questions.sample: My package says delivered, but I didn't get it.
questions.sample_ko: 택배가 배송 완료로 나오는데 받지 못했어요.

questions.q: I'm sorry to hear that. When did you order it?
questions.sample: I ordered it last Monday.

questions.q: Thanks. What was in the package?
questions.sample: It was a pair of headphones.

questions.q: Did you check with your neighbors or the security office?
questions.sample: I asked the security office, but they don't have it.

questions.q: I see. What would you like us to do, send a new one or refund you?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 새로 보내 드릴까요, 환불해 드릴까요?
questions.sample: I'd like a new one, please.

closing: Understood. We'll send a replacement within three days.
closing_ko: 알겠습니다. 3일 안에 새 제품을 보내 드리겠습니다.

title: At the Pharmacy
situation_ko: 감기에 걸려서 약국에 갔어요.

key_phrases.text: I've had a cough for three days.
How often should I take it?

questions.q: Hello. What seems to be the problem?
questions.sample: I have a sore throat and a cough.

questions.q: I see. How long have you had these symptoms?
questions.sample: For about three days.

questions.q: Do you have a fever?
questions.sample: No, but I feel a little tired.

questions.q: Are you allergic to any medicine?
questions.sample: No, I'm not allergic to anything.

questions.q: Good. Do you have any questions about the medicine?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 약에 대해 궁금한 점 있으세요?
questions.sample: How often should I take it, and can I take it before eating?
questions.sample_ko: 얼마나 자주 먹어야 하고, 식전에 먹어도 되나요?

closing: Take it three times a day after meals. Get some rest and feel better soon!
closing_ko: 하루 세 번 식후에 드세요. 푹 쉬고 얼른 나으세요!

title: Rainy Day Small Talk
situation_ko: 비 오는 날 엘리베이터에서 이웃과 대화해요.

key_phrases.text: I hope it clears up soon.

questions.q: Goodness, what a rainy day! Did you get wet this morning?
questions.q_ko: 어머, 비가 정말 많이 오네요! 오늘 아침에 젖었어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I got soaked because I forgot my umbrella.

questions.q: Oh dear. How do you feel on rainy days?
questions.q_ko: 저런. 비 오는 날에는 기분이 어때요?
questions.sample: I feel a bit sleepy, but I like the sound of rain.

questions.q: I like that too. What do you usually eat when it rains?
questions.q_ko: 저도 그래요. 비 올 때는 보통 뭘 먹어요?
questions.sample: I like to eat pancakes and drink makgeolli.

questions.q: How cozy! Do you have any plans for today?
questions.sample: I'm going to stay home and watch TV.

questions.q: Sounds nice. When do you think the rain will stop?
questions.sample: I heard it will clear up tomorrow afternoon.

closing: Let's hope so. Stay dry and warm!
closing_ko: 그러길 바라요. 젖지 말고 따뜻하게 지내요!

title: At the Hair Salon
situation_ko: 미용실에서 머리를 자르려고 해요.

key_phrases.text: I want to keep it short.

questions.q: Hi! What are we doing with your hair today?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 오늘 머리를 어떻게 해 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Just a trim, please.

questions.q: Sure. How short do you want it?
questions.sample: About two centimeters off the bottom.

questions.q: Okay. When was your last haircut?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 마지막으로 머리를 자른 게 언제예요?
questions.sample: About three months ago.

questions.q: I see. Do you want to change your style, or keep it the same?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 스타일을 바꾸고 싶으세요, 아니면 그대로 할까요?
questions.sample: I want to keep it the same because it's easy to style.

questions.q: Great. Is the water temperature okay for you?
questions.sample: It's a little hot, could you make it cooler?
questions.sample_ko: 조금 뜨거워요, 좀 더 시원하게 해 주실래요?

closing: All done! You look fantastic. See you next time!
closing_ko: 다 됐어요! 정말 멋져요. 다음에 또 오세요!

title: Dry Cleaning
situation_ko: 세탁소에 코트를 맡기러 갔어요.

key_phrases.text: There's a stain on the sleeve.
I'll pick it up on Friday.

questions.q: Hello! What do you have for me today?
questions.sample: I have a wool coat and two shirts.
questions.sample_ko: 울 코트 하나랑 셔츠 두 장이에요.

questions.q: Okay. Is there any stain I should know about?
questions.q_ko: 알겠습니다. 제가 알아야 할 얼룩이 있나요?
questions.sample: Yes, there's a coffee stain on the sleeve.

questions.q: I see it. How did that happen?
questions.sample: I spilled my coffee on the bus.

questions.q: That happens. When do you need them back?
questions.sample: I need them by Friday, if possible.

questions.q: No problem. Would you like to pay now or when you pick up?
questions.q_ko: 문제없어요. 지금 결제하실래요, 찾을 때 하실래요?
questions.sample: I'll pay when I pick them up.

closing: They'll be ready on Thursday evening. Thank you!
closing_ko: 목요일 저녁에 준비될 거예요. 감사합니다!

title: Setting Up Internet
situation_ko: 새 집에 인터넷 설치를 신청해요.

key_phrases.text: I need internet at my new home.

questions.q: Thanks for calling. How can I help you?
questions.sample: I need internet at my new apartment.

questions.q: Sure. What's your address?
questions.sample: It's 25 Sunrise Street, apartment 502.

questions.q: Thank you. How do you use the internet most?
questions.sample: I watch videos and work from home sometimes.

questions.q: Then I recommend the faster plan. Is that okay with your budget?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 더 빠른 요금제를 추천드려요. 예산은 괜찮으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, as long as it is under thirty thousand won.

questions.q: Good. Which day is best for the installation?
questions.q_ko: 좋습니다. 설치는 어느 날이 가장 좋으세요?
questions.sample: Saturday morning would be best.

closing: We'll see you Saturday at ten. Thank you for choosing us.
closing_ko: 토요일 10시에 뵙겠습니다. 저희를 선택해 주셔서 감사합니다.

title: Neighborhood Cafe
situation_ko: 단골 카페에서 주인과 이야기를 나눠요.

questions.q: Good morning! The usual?
questions.sample: Yes, a latte please, with less sugar.

questions.q: Coming right up. How often do you come here?
questions.q_ko: 바로 드릴게요. 여기 얼마나 자주 오세요?
questions.sample: I come here almost every weekend.

questions.q: That's great. What do you like about this place?
questions.sample: It's quiet, and I can read my book here.
questions.sample_ko: 조용하고 여기서 책을 읽을 수 있어서요.

questions.q: Nice. Do you want something to eat, like a muffin?
questions.q_ko: 좋네요. 머핀 같은 먹을 것도 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, I'll have a blueberry muffin.

questions.q: Good choice. Do you have plans for the rest of the day?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 선택이에요. 오늘 남은 시간에 계획이 있으세요?
questions.sample: I'm going to meet a friend this afternoon.

closing: Enjoy your coffee and your day!
closing_ko: 커피 맛있게 드시고 즐거운 하루 보내세요!

title: Parking Trouble
situation_ko: 이웃의 차가 당신 주차 자리를 막고 있어요.

questions.q: Hello. Is there a problem?
questions.sample: Excuse me, is the gray car yours?
questions.sample_ko: 실례지만, 저 회색 차 선생님 거예요?

questions.q: Yes, it is. Why do you ask?
questions.sample: It's in my parking space.

questions.q: Oh, I'm so sorry. I didn't know. Which number is yours?
questions.q_ko: 아, 정말 죄송해요. 몰랐어요. 몇 번 자리가 선생님 거예요?
questions.sample: It's number twelve, right here.

questions.q: I see now. I had a guest, and there was no space. Where should I park next time?
questions.q_ko: 이제 알겠네요. 손님이 와서 자리가 없었어요. 다음엔 어디에 주차해야 할까요?
questions.sample: There are visitor spaces near the gate.
questions.sample_ko: 정문 근처에 방문자 주차 공간이 있어요.

questions.q: Thanks for telling me. How soon do you need to park?
questions.q_ko: 알려 줘서 고마워요. 얼마나 빨리 주차하셔야 해요?
questions.sample: I'm going out now, but I'll be back in an hour.
questions.sample_ko: 지금 나가는데 한 시간 뒤에 돌아와요.

closing: I'll move it right now. Sorry again!
closing_ko: 지금 바로 옮길게요. 다시 한번 죄송해요!

title: Broken Elevator
situation_ko: 엘리베이터가 고장 나서 관리인과 이야기해요.
ai_role: Mr. Lee, the apartment security guard

key_phrases.text: I live on the twelfth floor.

questions.q: Hello. I'm sorry, but the elevator is out of service.
questions.sample: Oh no! How long will it take to fix it?

questions.q: Probably until this evening. Which floor do you live on?
questions.q_ko: 아마 오늘 저녁까지일 거예요. 몇 층에 사세요?
questions.sample: I live on the twelfth floor.

questions.q: That's high! Do you have something heavy with you?
questions.sample: Yes, I have two bags of groceries.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 장 본 짐이 두 봉지 있어요.

questions.q: I can help carry one bag. What's inside?
questions.q_ko: 한 봉지 들어 드릴게요. 안에 뭐가 있나요?
questions.sample: Mostly milk, fruit, and some vegetables.

questions.q: Okay. Would you prefer to wait for the elevator, or use the stairs?
questions.sample: I'll use the stairs with your help. Thank you.

closing: Take your time. Careful on the stairs!
closing_ko: 천천히 가세요. 계단 조심하세요!

title: Housewarming Party
situation_ko: 친구가 새 집으로 이사해서 집들이에 초대했어요.
ai_role: Hannah, a friend who just moved

questions.q: Welcome to my new home! What do you think of it?
questions.q_ko: 내 새 집에 어서 와요! 어때요?
questions.sample: Congratulations! I love the view from your window.

questions.q: Thanks! Which room do you like most?
questions.q_ko: 고마워요! 어느 방이 제일 마음에 들어요?
questions.sample: I like the kitchen because it's bright.

questions.q: I'm glad. By the way, what did you bring?
questions.sample: I brought a plant and some tissue paper.

questions.q: How thoughtful! Would you like something to drink?
questions.q_ko: 정말 세심하네요! 마실 것 좀 줄까요?
questions.sample: Yes, some orange juice would be nice.

questions.q: Sure. How was your trip here? Was it easy to find?
questions.q_ko: 그래요. 오는 길은 어땠어요? 찾기 쉬웠어요?
questions.sample: Yes, it was easy. It only took about twenty minutes.

closing: I'm so happy you came. Make yourself at home!
closing_ko: 와 줘서 정말 기뻐요. 편하게 있어요!

title: Walking in the Park
situation_ko: 공원에서 아침 산책을 하다가 이웃을 만났어요.
ai_role: Mr. Brown, a neighbor who jogs

questions.q: Good morning! Do you come to this park often?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 아침이에요! 이 공원에 자주 오세요?
questions.sample: Yes, I walk here every morning.

questions.q: That's great. How long do you usually walk?
questions.sample: About forty minutes.

questions.q: Impressive! Why did you start walking?
questions.sample: I'm trying to get healthier and lose some weight.

questions.q: Good for you. Does it help?
questions.sample: Yes, I sleep better and feel less stressed.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 잠도 잘 자고 스트레스도 덜 받아요.

questions.q: Wonderful. Do you walk alone or with someone?
questions.q_ko: 멋지네요. 혼자 걸으세요, 아니면 누구랑 같이 걸으세요?
questions.sample: Usually alone, but sometimes with my wife.
questions.sample_ko: 보통 혼자인데 가끔 아내와 같이 걸어요.

closing: Keep it up! Maybe we'll walk together someday.
closing_ko: 계속 화이팅이에요! 언젠가 같이 걸어요.

title: Working From Home or Office
situation_ko: 동료와 재택근무와 사무실 근무 중 어느 쪽이 나은지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: On the other hand, I save time.

questions.q: Do you prefer working from home or at the office? Why?
questions.q_ko: 재택근무와 사무실 근무 중 어느 쪽이 더 좋아요? 왜요?
questions.sample: I prefer the office because I can focus better there.
questions.sample_ko: 사무실이 더 좋아요. 거기서 더 집중이 잘 돼요.

questions.q: Interesting. What are some good things about working from home?
questions.q_ko: 흥미롭네요. 재택근무의 좋은 점은 뭐가 있을까요?
questions.sample: You save commuting time, and you can wear comfortable clothes.
questions.sample_ko: 출퇴근 시간을 아낄 수 있고 편한 옷을 입을 수 있어요.

questions.q: True. And what are the downsides?
questions.sample: It's hard to separate work from rest, so I tend to work too long.
questions.sample_ko: 일과 휴식을 구분하기 어려워서 너무 오래 일하게 돼요.

questions.q: I agree. How do you think teams communicate best?
questions.q_ko: 동의해요. 팀은 어떻게 소통하는 게 가장 좋다고 생각해요?
questions.sample: I think meeting in person sometimes is important, and chat tools can help the rest.
questions.sample_ko: 가끔은 직접 만나는 게 중요하고 나머지는 메신저로 해도 된다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Good point. If you could choose, how many days would you work from home?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 선택할 수 있다면 며칠이나 재택근무를 하고 싶어요?
questions.sample: Probably two days a week, so I get a good balance.

closing: That's a balanced view. Thanks for sharing your thoughts!
closing_ko: 균형 잡힌 생각이네요. 의견 나눠 줘서 고마워요!

title: Living Alone
situation_ko: 친구와 혼자 사는 것의 장단점을 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: I enjoy having my own space.
I have to do everything myself.

questions.q: Would you rather live alone or with other people? Why?
questions.q_ko: 혼자 사는 게 좋아요, 다른 사람과 같이 사는 게 좋아요? 왜요?
questions.sample: I'd rather live alone because I enjoy having my own space.
questions.sample_ko: 저는 나만의 공간이 좋아서 혼자 사는 게 좋아요.

questions.q: I get that. What is the hardest part of living alone?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 혼자 사는 데서 가장 힘든 점이 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I think it's cooking and cleaning, because I have to do everything myself.
questions.sample_ko: 요리와 청소요. 다 혼자 해야 하니까요.

questions.q: Yeah. Do you ever feel lonely?
questions.sample: Sometimes, especially on weekends, but I call friends or family.
questions.sample_ko: 가끔, 특히 주말에요. 그럴 땐 친구나 가족에게 전화해요.

questions.q: That helps. What advice would you give someone who is about to live alone?
questions.q_ko: 도움이 되겠네요. 곧 혼자 살게 될 사람에게 어떤 조언을 해 주고 싶어요?
questions.sample: I'd say make a budget and make a few easy meals you like.
questions.sample_ko: 예산을 세우고 좋아하는 간단한 요리 몇 가지를 배워 두라고 하고 싶어요.

questions.q: Great advice. Do you think you'll live alone for a long time?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 조언이에요. 오랫동안 혼자 살 것 같아요?
questions.sample: Maybe a few more years, but I might share a home someday.
questions.sample_ko: 몇 년은 더 그럴 것 같지만 언젠가는 같이 살 수도 있어요.

closing: It sounds like you've found a good balance. Thanks for chatting!
closing_ko: 좋은 균형을 찾으신 것 같아요. 이야기해 줘서 고마워요!

title: Apartment or House
situation_ko: 부동산 중개인과 어떤 집에 살고 싶은지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: It's a bit out of my budget.

questions.q: Are you looking for an apartment or a house? Why?
questions.sample: An apartment, because it's safer and more convenient.

questions.q: That's popular. What's most important to you in a home?
questions.q_ko: 인기가 많죠. 집에서 가장 중요한 게 뭐예요?
questions.sample: Being close to the subway is the most important thing for me.

questions.q: Understood. Do you prefer a new building or an older one with more character?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 새 건물이 좋으세요, 아니면 개성 있는 오래된 건물이 좋으세요?
questions.sample: A newer one, since older places often have problems with heating.
questions.sample_ko: 새 건물이요. 오래된 곳은 난방 문제가 자주 있으니까요.

questions.q: Fair enough. What do you think about the neighborhood, quiet or lively?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 동네는 조용한 곳이 좋아요, 활기찬 곳이 좋아요?
questions.sample: Somewhere quiet, but with a few shops and cafes nearby.
questions.sample_ko: 조용하지만 근처에 가게와 카페가 조금 있는 곳이요.

questions.q: I have a few options. How flexible is your budget?
questions.q_ko: 몇 가지 매물이 있어요. 예산은 어느 정도 융통성이 있나요?
questions.sample: I can go a little higher if the place is really good.
questions.sample_ko: 정말 좋은 집이라면 조금 더 낼 수 있어요.

closing: Great. I'll find some places for you to see this weekend.
closing_ko: 좋아요. 이번 주말에 보실 만한 집들을 찾아볼게요.

title: Recycling and the Environment
situation_ko: 이웃과 쓰레기와 환경 문제에 대해 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: It's a small thing, but it matters.
I try to bring my own bag.

questions.q: Do you think recycling really makes a difference? Why or why not?
questions.q_ko: 분리수거가 정말 변화를 만든다고 생각해요? 왜요?
questions.sample: Yes, I think it helps, even if it's a small thing.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 작은 일이라도 도움이 된다고 생각해요.

questions.q: I agree. What do you do at home to reduce waste?
questions.q_ko: 동의해요. 쓰레기를 줄이기 위해 집에서 뭘 해요?
questions.sample: I bring my own bag and avoid using disposable cups.
questions.sample_ko: 장바구니를 가져가고 일회용 컵을 쓰지 않으려고 해요.

questions.q: Good habits. Is it hard to follow the rules in your building?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 습관이네요. 건물 규칙을 지키기 어려워요?
questions.sample: A little, because sorting takes time, but I'm getting used to it.
questions.sample_ko: 분리하는 데 시간이 걸려서 조금 그렇지만 익숙해지고 있어요.

questions.q: I know what you mean. Who should be responsible, people or companies?
questions.q_ko: 무슨 뜻인지 알아요. 책임은 누구에게 있어야 할까요, 개인일까요, 기업일까요?
questions.sample: Both, but I think companies should use less plastic packaging.
questions.sample_ko: 둘 다요. 하지만 기업이 포장재를 덜 써야 한다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Well said. What's one change you'd like to make this year?
questions.q_ko: 맞는 말이에요. 올해 하고 싶은 변화가 하나 있다면요?
questions.sample: I want to buy fewer things I don't need.
questions.sample_ko: 필요 없는 물건을 덜 사고 싶어요.

closing: That's a great goal. Little steps add up!
closing_ko: 멋진 목표네요. 작은 노력이 모여요!

title: Pets in Apartments
situation_ko: 아파트 주민 회의에서 반려동물 문제를 토론해요.
ai_role: Mr. Kim, the resident committee head

questions.q: Should people be allowed to keep pets in apartments? Why?
questions.q_ko: 아파트에서 반려동물을 키우도록 허용해야 할까요? 왜요?
questions.sample: I think yes, because pets bring joy, as long as owners are responsible.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 주인이 책임을 진다면 반려동물이 기쁨을 주니까요.

questions.q: I see. What problems can pets cause for neighbors?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 반려동물이 이웃에게 어떤 문제를 일으킬 수 있을까요?
questions.sample: Barking and smells can be a problem, especially at night.
questions.sample_ko: 특히 밤에 짖는 소리와 냄새가 문제일 수 있어요.

questions.q: That's true. What rules would you suggest?
questions.sample: Keep dogs on a leash in common areas and clean up after them.
questions.sample_ko: 공용 공간에서는 목줄을 하고 배설물을 치우도록 해야 해요.

questions.q: Reasonable. What if someone breaks the rules?
questions.sample: First a warning, and then a small fine if it happens again.
questions.sample_ko: 먼저 경고를 하고 반복되면 소액의 벌금을 내게 하면 좋겠어요.

questions.q: Fair. Do you have a pet, or would you like one?
questions.sample: I'd love a cat someday, but my schedule is too busy right now.
questions.sample_ko: 언젠가 고양이를 키우고 싶지만 지금은 일정이 너무 바빠요.

closing: Thank you for your ideas. We'll bring them to the meeting.
closing_ko: 의견 감사합니다. 회의에서 반영하겠습니다.

title: How Holidays Have Changed
situation_ko: 할머니와 명절 문화가 어떻게 달라졌는지 이야기해요.

questions.q: When I was young, the whole family cooked for days. How do you feel about holidays today?
questions.q_ko: 내가 어렸을 땐 온 가족이 며칠씩 음식을 했단다. 요즘 명절은 어떻게 느껴지니?
questions.sample: I think they're simpler now, and I like that because everyone has less stress.
questions.sample_ko: 요즘은 더 간소해졌고, 다들 스트레스가 덜해서 좋다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Hmm, I see. What do you miss about the old way?
questions.q_ko: 음, 그렇구나. 예전 방식에서 그리운 점이 뭐니?
questions.sample: I miss how everyone sat together and told stories.
questions.sample_ko: 모두 함께 앉아서 이야기를 나누던 게 그리워요.

questions.q: That was lovely. Do you think young people should cook for the holidays?
questions.q_ko: 그건 참 좋았지. 젊은 사람들이 명절 음식을 해야 한다고 생각하니?
questions.sample: I think everyone should help, men and women, so it's fair.
questions.sample_ko: 남자든 여자든 모두 도와야 공평하다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Times are changing. Would you rather travel or stay home on a holiday?
questions.q_ko: 시대가 변하는구나. 명절에 여행을 가고 싶니, 집에 있고 싶니?
questions.sample: I'd like to do both, visiting family first and then traveling a little.
questions.sample_ko: 둘 다 하고 싶어요. 먼저 가족을 만나고 그다음에 조금 여행하고요.

questions.q: That's a good plan. What tradition do you want to keep for the future?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 계획이구나. 앞으로도 지키고 싶은 전통은 뭐니?
questions.sample: I want to keep eating together and bowing to the elders.
questions.sample_ko: 함께 식사하고 어른들께 세배드리는 걸 계속하고 싶어요.

closing: You make me proud. Come visit me soon, dear.
closing_ko: 네가 자랑스럽구나. 곧 놀러 오렴.

title: Commuting: Car or Transit
situation_ko: 동료와 출퇴근 방법의 장단점을 이야기해요.

key_phrases.ko: 저는 대중교통을 타는 게 낫다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Do you think it's better to drive or take public transport to work? Why?
questions.q_ko: 출근할 때 운전하는 게 나을까요, 대중교통이 나을까요? 왜요?
questions.sample: I think public transport is better, because traffic is awful and parking is expensive.
questions.sample_ko: 교통체증도 심하고 주차도 비싸서 대중교통이 낫다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Fair point. What do you like about taking the subway or bus?
questions.q_ko: 일리 있어요. 지하철이나 버스 타는 것의 좋은 점은 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I can read or rest instead of focusing on the road.
questions.sample_ko: 운전에 집중하는 대신 책을 읽거나 쉴 수 있어요.

questions.q: True. But what are the disadvantages?
questions.sample: It's crowded during rush hour, and I can't leave whenever I want.
questions.sample_ko: 출퇴근 시간엔 붐비고 원할 때 마음대로 갈 수 없어요.

questions.q: I agree. Would you ever buy a car?
questions.sample: Maybe if I had kids, because it would make family trips easier.
questions.sample_ko: 아이가 생기면요. 가족 여행이 편해질 테니까요.

questions.q: That makes sense. How would you improve commuting in your city?
questions.q_ko: 이해가 가요. 이 도시의 출퇴근을 어떻게 개선하고 싶으세요?
questions.sample: I'd add more buses at night and make the transfers faster.
questions.sample_ko: 밤에 버스를 더 늘리고 환승을 더 빠르게 하고 싶어요.

closing: Interesting views! I might try taking the bus next week.
closing_ko: 흥미로운 생각이에요! 다음 주에 저도 버스를 타 볼까 봐요.

title: Deciding to Move
situation_ko: 이사를 할지 말지 고민하며 친구에게 조언을 구해요.

questions.q: You've been thinking about moving, right? What's the main reason?
questions.q_ko: 이사를 고민 중이라고 했죠? 가장 큰 이유가 뭐예요?
questions.sample: The rent keeps going up, and my commute is too long.
questions.sample_ko: 월세가 계속 오르고 통근 시간도 너무 길어서요.

questions.q: That's tough. What would be your ideal neighborhood?
questions.sample: Somewhere close to my work with a park nearby.
questions.sample_ko: 직장과 가깝고 근처에 공원이 있는 곳이요.

questions.q: Sounds nice. What worries you about moving?
questions.q_ko: 좋네요. 이사하는 것에 대해 걱정되는 건 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I'm worried about the cost and starting over with new neighbors.
questions.sample_ko: 비용이랑 새 이웃과 다시 시작해야 하는 게 걱정돼요.

questions.q: That's understandable. How would you pay for the move?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 이사 비용은 어떻게 마련할 거예요?
questions.sample: I've saved some money, and I'll sell a few things I don't need.
questions.sample_ko: 모아 둔 돈이 조금 있고, 필요 없는 물건은 팔 거예요.

questions.q: Smart. If you could give yourself advice, would you move or stay?
questions.sample: I think I'd move, because staying will only get more expensive.
questions.sample_ko: 머무르면 더 비싸질 테니 이사하는 게 낫다고 생각해요.

closing: Whatever you decide, I'll help you pack. Good luck!
closing_ko: 뭘 결정하든 짐 싸는 거 도와줄게요. 행운을 빌어요!

title: Neighbors in the City
situation_ko: 이웃과 도시에서 이웃끼리 얼마나 가까워야 하는지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: People keep to themselves these days.
A simple hello goes a long way.

questions.q: In my day, we knew everyone on the street. Do you know your neighbors well?
questions.q_ko: 내가 젊을 땐 동네 사람들을 다 알았어요. 이웃을 잘 알아요?
questions.sample: Not really. I only know a few people by name.

questions.q: I see. Why do you think that is?
questions.sample: People are busy, and many value their privacy.

questions.q: Perhaps. Do you think neighbors should help each other?
questions.q_ko: 그럴 수도 있겠네요. 이웃끼리 서로 도와야 한다고 생각해요?
questions.sample: Yes, especially in emergencies, like when someone is sick.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 특히 누군가 아플 때 같은 위급한 상황에서요.

questions.q: That's kind. What small thing could neighbors do to feel closer?
questions.q_ko: 친절하네요. 이웃끼리 가까워지려면 어떤 작은 일을 하면 좋을까요?
questions.sample: Just saying hello in the elevator or sharing some food during holidays.
questions.sample_ko: 엘리베이터에서 인사하거나 명절에 음식을 나누는 거요.

questions.q: I like that. Would you join a neighborhood event if there was one?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 동네 행사가 있으면 참여하겠어요?
questions.sample: Yes, if it was short and fun, like a small picnic.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 짧고 재미있는 작은 소풍 같은 거라면요.

closing: Maybe I'll organize one. Thank you for the idea!
closing_ko: 제가 하나 준비해 볼까 봐요. 아이디어 고마워요!

title: Online or In-Store Shopping
situation_ko: 친구와 온라인 쇼핑과 매장 쇼핑 중 뭐가 나은지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: I like to see things in person.

questions.q: Do you prefer shopping online or in stores? Why?
questions.q_ko: 온라인 쇼핑이 좋아요, 매장 쇼핑이 좋아요? 왜요?
questions.sample: Online, because it's cheaper and saves me time.
questions.sample_ko: 온라인이요. 더 싸고 시간도 아낄 수 있어서요.

questions.q: Makes sense. What do you usually buy online?
questions.q_ko: 이해가 가요. 온라인에서는 주로 뭘 사요?
questions.sample: Groceries, books, and household things.

questions.q: Handy. Is there anything you would never buy online?
questions.q_ko: 편리하네요. 절대 온라인에서 안 사는 게 있어요?
questions.sample: Shoes, because I need to try them on to see if they fit.
questions.sample_ko: 신발이요. 신어 봐야 맞는지 알 수 있으니까요.

questions.q: Good point. What do you think is the biggest problem with online shopping?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 온라인 쇼핑의 가장 큰 문제는 뭐라고 생각해요?
questions.sample: Returns can be a hassle, and I sometimes buy things I don't need.
questions.sample_ko: 반품이 번거롭고 필요 없는 것도 가끔 사게 돼요.

questions.q: So true. How do you control your spending?
questions.sample: I put things in my cart and wait a day before buying.
questions.sample_ko: 장바구니에 담아 두고 하루 기다렸다가 사요.

closing: That's a smart trick. I'll try it too!
closing_ko: 똑똑한 방법이네요. 저도 해 볼게요!

title: Mobile Banking vs Branch
situation_ko: 은행 직원과 모바일 뱅킹과 지점 방문의 장단점을 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: I use my phone for most things.
I feel safer talking to a person.

questions.q: Do you usually do your banking on your phone or at a branch? Why?
questions.q_ko: 은행 업무는 보통 휴대폰으로 하세요, 지점에서 하세요? 이유는요?
questions.sample: On my phone, because it's quick and convenient.

questions.q: Many people do. Is there anything you still do at the branch?
questions.q_ko: 많은 분들이 그래요. 아직도 지점에서 하는 일이 있으세요?
questions.sample: Big things, like taking out a loan, because I want to talk to a person.
questions.sample_ko: 대출 같은 큰 일은 사람과 이야기하고 싶어서 지점에서 해요.

questions.q: Understandable. Do you worry about the security of mobile banking?
questions.sample: A little, so I use a strong password and never click strange links.
questions.sample_ko: 조금요. 그래서 강력한 비밀번호를 쓰고 이상한 링크는 누르지 않아요.

questions.q: Wise. Do you think older people have trouble with it?
questions.sample: Yes, I think so. Banks should offer more help and simple screens.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 그런 것 같아요. 은행이 더 많은 도움과 간단한 화면을 제공해야 해요.

questions.q: Good suggestion. Do you think bank branches will disappear in the future?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 제안이에요. 앞으로 은행 지점이 없어질 거라고 생각하세요?
questions.sample: Many will close, but a few will stay for people who need help.
questions.sample_ko: 많이 문을 닫겠지만 도움이 필요한 사람을 위해 일부는 남을 거예요.

closing: Thank you for your thoughts. We'll keep improving our service.
closing_ko: 의견 감사합니다. 서비스를 계속 개선하겠습니다.

title: Sharing Chores Fairly
situation_ko: 룸메이트와 집안일을 어떻게 나눌지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: I think we should take turns.

questions.q: I feel like I do more chores than you. How do you think we should divide them?
questions.q_ko: 제가 집안일을 더 많이 하는 것 같아요. 어떻게 나누면 좋을까요?
questions.sample: I think we should take turns every week.
questions.sample_ko: 매주 번갈아 하는 게 좋을 것 같아요.

questions.q: Okay. Which chores do you prefer to do?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 어떤 집안일을 하는 게 더 나아요?
questions.sample: I prefer cooking and laundry, but I dislike cleaning the bathroom.
questions.sample_ko: 요리와 빨래가 낫고, 화장실 청소는 싫어요.

questions.q: Fair. What should we do about the chore nobody likes?
questions.q_ko: 공정하네요. 아무도 하기 싫은 일은 어떻게 할까요?
questions.sample: We could rotate it, or the person who does it can skip another chore.
questions.sample_ko: 돌아가면서 하거나 그걸 한 사람은 다른 일을 빼 주면 좋겠어요.

questions.q: Good idea. What if one of us is too busy one week?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 한 사람이 어느 주에 너무 바쁘면요?
questions.sample: We should tell each other early, and the other person can help, then we trade back later.
questions.sample_ko: 미리 말해 주고 다른 사람이 도와준 다음 나중에 갚으면 돼요.

questions.q: That works. How can we remind each other without arguing?
questions.q_ko: 괜찮네요. 싸우지 않고 서로 어떻게 알려 줄 수 있을까요?
questions.sample: Let's put a chart on the fridge and speak kindly if something is missed.
questions.sample_ko: 냉장고에 표를 붙이고 놓친 게 있으면 부드럽게 말해요.

closing: Great, I feel better already. Let's write the schedule tonight.
closing_ko: 좋아요, 벌써 마음이 편해졌어요. 오늘 밤에 일정표를 써요.

title: Big or Small Birthday
situation_ko: 친구와 생일을 어떻게 보내는 게 좋은지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: I get nervous with big crowds.

questions.q: Do you prefer a big birthday party or a quiet celebration? Why?
questions.q_ko: 큰 생일 파티가 좋아요, 조용한 축하가 좋아요? 왜요?
questions.sample: A quiet one, because I get nervous with big crowds.

questions.q: I understand. What was your most memorable birthday?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 가장 기억에 남는 생일은 언제예요?
questions.sample: My thirtieth, when my friends surprised me with a cake at work.
questions.sample_ko: 서른 번째 생일에 친구들이 회사에서 케이크로 깜짝 파티를 해 줬어요.

questions.q: How sweet! Do you think expensive gifts are important?
questions.q_ko: 정말 다정하네요! 비싼 선물이 중요하다고 생각해요?
questions.sample: Not at all. I think it's the thought that counts.

questions.q: I agree. What is the best gift you've ever received?
questions.q_ko: 동의해요. 지금까지 받은 최고의 선물은 뭐예요?
questions.sample: A handwritten letter from my friend, because it was so personal.
questions.sample_ko: 친구가 손으로 쓴 편지요. 정말 개인적이어서요.

questions.q: Lovely. How do you like to celebrate other people's birthdays?
questions.q_ko: 멋지네요. 다른 사람의 생일은 어떻게 축하하는 걸 좋아해요?
questions.sample: I like to send a message first thing in the morning and take them to lunch.
questions.sample_ko: 아침 일찍 메시지를 보내고 점심을 사 주는 걸 좋아해요.

closing: That's thoughtful. Your friends are lucky to have you!
closing_ko: 사려 깊네요. 친구들은 당신이 있어서 행운이에요!

title: Weather and Mood
situation_ko: 친구와 날씨가 기분에 어떤 영향을 주는지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: Gray days make me feel down.
I try to go outside anyway.

questions.q: Does the weather affect your mood? How?
questions.sample: Yes, gray days make me feel down, and sunny days give me energy.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 흐린 날엔 기분이 가라앉고 맑은 날엔 에너지가 생겨요.

questions.q: Same here. What do you do on gloomy days?
questions.q_ko: 저도 그래요. 우울한 날엔 뭘 해요?
questions.sample: I turn on warm lights, drink tea, and call a friend.
questions.sample_ko: 따뜻한 조명을 켜고 차를 마시며 친구에게 전화해요.

questions.q: Great tips. Which season makes you happiest, and why?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 방법이네요. 어느 계절에 가장 행복해요? 왜요?
questions.sample: Autumn, because the weather is mild and the leaves are beautiful.

questions.q: Beautiful. Is there any weather that you really can't stand?
questions.q_ko: 아름답죠. 정말 못 견디는 날씨가 있어요?
questions.sample: Humid summer days, because I sweat a lot and can't sleep.
questions.sample_ko: 습한 여름날이요. 땀이 많이 나고 잠을 못 자서요.

questions.q: Ugh, I know. If you could live in any climate, what would you choose?
questions.q_ko: 으, 알아요. 어떤 기후에서든 살 수 있다면 어디를 선택할래요?
questions.sample: Somewhere mild, like the south coast, with sun but not too hot.
questions.sample_ko: 해가 있지만 너무 덥지 않은 남쪽 해안처럼 온화한 곳이요.

closing: That sounds perfect. Let's plan a trip there someday!
closing_ko: 완벽하네요. 언젠가 거기로 여행 계획 세워요!

title: Morning Person or Night Owl
situation_ko: 동료와 아침형 인간과 저녁형 인간 중 어느 쪽인지 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: I work best in the morning.
key_phrases.ko: 저는 아침에 일이 제일 잘 돼요.

key_phrases.text: It's hard to change my habits.

questions.q: Are you a morning person or a night owl? How do you know?
questions.sample: I'm a night owl because I feel most awake after nine at night.
questions.sample_ko: 밤 9시 이후에 가장 정신이 맑아서 저녁형이에요.

questions.q: Interesting. How does that affect your work?
questions.q_ko: 흥미롭네요. 그게 일에 어떤 영향을 줘요?
questions.sample: It's hard to focus in early meetings, but I do my best thinking in the evening.
questions.sample_ko: 이른 회의에서는 집중하기 어렵지만 저녁에 가장 좋은 생각이 나요.

questions.q: I can imagine. Have you ever tried to change your habits?
questions.q_ko: 그럴 것 같아요. 습관을 바꿔 보려고 한 적 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, but it's hard. After a few days I went back to my old schedule.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 하지만 어려웠어요. 며칠 후에 예전 생활로 돌아갔어요.

questions.q: That happens. Do you think companies should allow flexible working hours?
questions.q_ko: 그런 일이 흔하죠. 회사가 유연 근무 시간을 허용해야 한다고 생각해요?
questions.sample: Yes, I think people are more productive when they work at their best time.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 가장 컨디션 좋은 시간에 일할 때 생산성이 높아진다고 생각해요.

questions.q: Good point. What advice would you give to someone who struggles with mornings?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 아침이 힘든 사람에게 어떤 조언을 해 주겠어요?
questions.sample: Go to bed a bit earlier, open the curtains right away, and have a good breakfast.
questions.sample_ko: 조금 일찍 자고, 일어나자마자 커튼을 열고, 아침을 잘 먹으라고 하겠어요.

closing: Great advice. Thanks for the fun chat!
closing_ko: 좋은 조언이에요. 즐거운 대화 고마워요!

title: Airport Check-in
situation_ko: 공항 카운터에서 비행기 체크인을 해요.

questions.q: Hello! May I see your passport?
questions.sample: Sure. Here is my passport.

questions.q: Thank you. Where are you flying to today?
questions.sample: I'm going to Tokyo.

questions.q: Nice! How many bags do you have?
questions.sample: I have one bag.

questions.q: OK. Do you want a window seat or an aisle seat?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 창가 자리와 통로 자리 중 어느 쪽이 좋으세요?
questions.sample: A window seat, please.

questions.q: Great. Is this your first time in Japan?
questions.sample: No, I went there two years ago.

closing: All done! Here is your boarding pass. Have a nice flight!
closing_ko: 다 됐어요! 탑승권 여기 있어요. 즐거운 비행 되세요!

title: Passport Control
situation_ko: 다른 나라에 도착해서 입국 심사를 받아요.
user_role: A visitor arriving in a new country

questions.q: Good morning. What is the purpose of your visit?
questions.sample: I'm here on vacation.

questions.q: Great. How long will you stay?
questions.sample: I'll stay for five days.

questions.q: OK. Where will you stay?
questions.sample: I'm staying at a hotel in the city center.

questions.q: Good. Are you traveling alone?
questions.sample: No, I'm with my friend.

questions.q: Nice. What do you want to see here?
questions.sample: I want to see the old castle.

closing: Thank you. Welcome, and enjoy your stay!
closing_ko: 감사합니다. 환영해요, 즐거운 시간 보내세요!

title: Hotel Check-in
situation_ko: 호텔 프런트에서 체크인을 해요.

questions.q: Welcome to the hotel! Do you have a reservation?
questions.sample: Yes, I have a reservation.

questions.q: Great. What's your name, please?
questions.sample: My name is Minho Kim.

questions.q: Thank you. How many nights are you staying?
questions.sample: For two nights.

questions.q: OK. Do you need anything for your room?
questions.sample: Yes, I need an extra towel.

questions.q: Sure! Do you have any questions for me?
questions.sample: What time is breakfast?

closing: Here is your key. Room 305. Enjoy your stay!
closing_ko: 열쇠 여기 있어요. 305호예요. 즐거운 시간 보내세요!

title: Asking for Directions
situation_ko: 낯선 거리에서 길을 물어봐요.
ai_role: A friendly local on the street

key_phrases.text: Excuse me, where is the station?

questions.q: Hi! You look lost. Can I help you?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 길을 잃으신 것 같아요. 도와드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, please. Where is the station?

questions.q: The station? Go straight and turn left. Do you understand?
questions.sample: Can you say it again, please?

questions.q: Sure. Straight, then left. Do you want to walk or take a bus?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요. 직진 후 왼쪽이에요. 걸어갈래요, 버스를 탈래요?
questions.sample: I want to walk. Is it far?

questions.q: Not far, about ten minutes. Where are you from?
questions.sample: I'm from Korea.

questions.q: Oh, nice! Do you like it here?
questions.sample: Yes, I like it very much.

closing: Great! Enjoy your trip, and have a nice day!
closing_ko: 좋아요! 여행 즐겁게 하시고, 좋은 하루 보내세요!

title: Buying a Train Ticket
situation_ko: 역 매표소에서 기차표를 사요.

key_phrases.ko: 부산 가는 표 한 장 주세요.

questions.q: Hello. Where do you want to go?
questions.sample: One ticket to Busan, please.
questions.sample_ko: 부산 가는 표 한 장 주세요.

questions.q: OK. One way or round trip?
questions.sample: A round trip, please.

questions.q: Sure. When do you want to go?
questions.sample: Tomorrow morning.

questions.q: We have a train at nine. Is that OK?
questions.sample: Yes, that's good. When does it arrive?

questions.q: At noon. Will you pay by card or cash?
questions.sample: By card, please.

closing: Here is your ticket. Have a good trip!
closing_ko: 표 여기 있어요. 좋은 여행 되세요!

title: Hotel Breakfast
situation_ko: 호텔 식당에서 아침을 주문해요.

questions.q: Good morning! How many people?
questions.sample: Just one, please.

questions.q: Right this way. What would you like to drink?
questions.sample: Coffee, please.

questions.q: Sure! Do you want to eat eggs or pancakes?
questions.sample: I'd like eggs and toast.

questions.q: Good choice. How do you want your eggs?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 선택이에요. 계란은 어떻게 해 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Scrambled, please.

questions.q: OK! What are you going to do today?
questions.sample: I'm going to visit the museum.

closing: Great plan! Your food will be ready soon. Enjoy!
closing_ko: 멋진 계획이에요! 음식은 곧 나와요. 맛있게 드세요!

title: Taking a Taxi
situation_ko: 택시를 타고 목적지를 말해요.

questions.q: Hello! Where to?
questions.sample: To the airport, please.

questions.q: OK. Are you in a hurry?
questions.sample: Yes, my flight is at three.

questions.q: I see. Do you want me to take the highway?
questions.sample: Yes, please. How long will it take?

questions.q: About thirty minutes. Is this your first time here?
questions.sample: Yes, it is.

questions.q: Welcome! What do you like about this city?
questions.sample: I like the food. It's very good.

closing: We're here! That's twenty dollars. Safe travels!
closing_ko: 도착했어요! 20달러예요. 안전한 여행 되세요!

title: Buying a Souvenir
situation_ko: 기념품 가게에서 선물을 골라요.

key_phrases.text: It's a gift for my mom.
Can I have a smaller one?
key_phrases.ko: 더 작은 걸 주실 수 있어요?

questions.q: Hello! Are you looking for something special?
questions.sample: Yes, I want a small gift.

questions.q: Nice! Who is it for?
questions.sample: It's a gift for my mom.

questions.q: How sweet! Does she like cups or scarves?
questions.q_ko: 다정하네요! 어머니는 컵을 좋아하세요, 스카프를 좋아하세요?
questions.sample: She likes scarves.

questions.q: This blue one is very pretty. What do you think?
questions.q_ko: 이 파란 건 아주 예뻐요. 어때요?
questions.sample: I like it. How much is it?

questions.q: It's fifteen dollars. Do you want anything else?
questions.sample: No, thank you. Just this one.

closing: Thank you! I hope your mom loves it. Come again!
closing_ko: 감사합니다! 어머니가 좋아하시길 바라요. 또 오세요!

title: Taking a City Bus Abroad
situation_ko: 버스 정류장에서 어느 버스를 타야 하는지 물어요.
user_role: A passenger at a bus stop

key_phrases.text: Does this bus go to the beach?
Tell me when we arrive, please.

questions.q: Hi! Where are you going?
questions.sample: I'm going to the beach.

questions.q: This bus goes there. Do you have a ticket?
questions.q_ko: 이 버스가 거기 가요. 표 있으세요?
questions.sample: No. How much is the ticket?

questions.q: It's two dollars. Do you have coins?
questions.sample: Yes, here you are.

questions.q: Thanks. Do you want to sit down? There's a seat in the back.
questions.sample: Yes, thank you. Tell me when we arrive, please.

questions.q: Sure. What will you do at the beach?
questions.sample: I want to swim and take photos.

closing: Sounds fun! I'll tell you when we get there. Relax!
closing_ko: 재밌겠네요! 도착하면 알려 드릴게요. 편히 계세요!

title: Missing Suitcase
situation_ko: 공항에서 내 가방이 나오지 않아 직원에게 말해요.
user_role: A traveler whose bag did not arrive

questions.q: Hello. How can I help you?
questions.sample: My bag is missing.

questions.q: I'm sorry to hear that. What does it look like?
questions.sample: It's a big black bag.

questions.q: OK. What flight did you take?
questions.sample: I took the flight from Seoul.

questions.q: Thank you. Where are you staying in the city?
questions.sample: I'm staying at the Green Hotel.

questions.q: Good. Do you have a phone number?
questions.sample: Yes. Please call me when you find it.

closing: Don't worry. We will find your bag soon.
closing_ko: 걱정 마세요. 곧 가방을 찾을 거예요.

title: Tourist Information
situation_ko: 관광 안내소에서 가 볼 만한 곳을 물어요.

questions.q: Welcome! How can I help you?
questions.sample: What should I see in this city?

questions.q: There are many places. Do you like museums or parks?
questions.q_ko: 많은 곳이 있어요. 박물관을 좋아하세요, 공원을 좋아하세요?
questions.sample: I like parks.

questions.q: Then try Central Park. How many days are you here?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 센트럴 파크에 가 보세요. 며칠 계세요?
questions.sample: Three days.

questions.q: Nice! Do you want a map?
questions.sample: Yes, please. Is it free?

questions.q: Yes, it's free. Are you here with family?
questions.sample: No, I'm alone.

closing: Here is your map. Enjoy the city!
closing_ko: 지도 여기 있어요. 도시를 즐기세요!

title: Taking a Photo
situation_ko: 관광지에서 지나가는 사람에게 사진을 부탁해요.
user_role: A tourist asking for a photo

key_phrases.text: Can you take a photo, please?

questions.q: Hi there! Do you need something?
questions.sample: Yes. Can you take a photo, please?

questions.q: Of course! Is it OK here?
questions.sample: Yes. Please take the tower, too.
questions.sample_ko: 네. 타워도 같이 나오게 해 주세요.

questions.q: OK, smile! One, two, three. Do you like it?
questions.q_ko: 자, 웃으세요! 하나, 둘, 셋. 마음에 드세요?
questions.sample: It's nice. One more, please.

questions.q: Sure. Are you on vacation?
questions.sample: Yes, I came with my sister.

questions.q: How nice! What is your favorite place so far?
questions.q_ko: 좋네요! 지금까지 가장 좋았던 곳은 어디예요?
questions.sample: I like this tower the most.

closing: Great! Have a lovely trip with your sister!
closing_ko: 좋아요! 언니와 즐거운 여행 하세요!

title: Changing Money
situation_ko: 환전소에서 돈을 바꿔요.

questions.q: Hello! How can I help you?
questions.sample: I want to change money.

questions.q: Sure. What money do you have?
questions.sample: I have Korean won.

questions.q: OK. How much do you want to change?
questions.sample: One hundred thousand won.

questions.q: Got it. Do you want big bills or small bills?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 큰 지폐가 좋아요, 작은 지폐가 좋아요?
questions.sample: Small bills, please.

questions.q: No problem. What will you buy with the money?
questions.q_ko: 문제없어요. 그 돈으로 뭘 살 거예요?
questions.sample: I will buy food and gifts.

closing: Here is your money. Please count it. Have a nice day!
closing_ko: 돈 여기 있어요. 세어 보세요. 좋은 하루 보내세요!

title: Hotel Wi-Fi
situation_ko: 호텔 방에서 와이파이가 안 돼서 프런트에 물어요.

questions.q: Hello, front desk. How can I help?
questions.sample: What is the Wi-Fi password?

questions.q: It's on the card in your room. Did you see it?
questions.q_ko: 방에 있는 카드에 적혀 있어요. 보셨어요?
questions.sample: Yes, but it doesn't work.

questions.q: I'm sorry about that. What's your room number?
questions.sample: Room 502.

questions.q: Thanks. Are you using a phone or a computer?
questions.sample: I'm using my phone.

questions.q: I see. Do you need it for work?
questions.sample: No, I want to call my family.

closing: OK, I'll send someone to help you now. Thanks for waiting!
closing_ko: 알겠어요, 지금 도와줄 직원을 보낼게요. 기다려 주셔서 감사해요!

title: At the Boarding Gate
situation_ko: 탑승 게이트에서 비행기를 기다리며 직원과 이야기해요.

questions.q: Hi! May I see your boarding pass?
questions.sample: Sure. Is this gate 12?

questions.q: Yes, it is. You're on the flight to Paris. Is that right?
questions.sample: Yes. When do we board?

questions.q: In twenty minutes. Are you traveling for work?
questions.sample: No, for fun.

questions.q: Great! Is this your first time in Paris?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm so excited.

questions.q: Wonderful! What do you want to eat there?
questions.sample: I want to eat bread and cheese.

closing: Yum! Please wait here. We'll call you soon. Enjoy Paris!
closing_ko: 맛있겠네요! 여기서 기다려 주세요. 곧 부를게요. 파리를 즐기세요!

title: Booking a City Tour
situation_ko: 여행사에서 하루 시내 투어를 예약해요.

key_phrases.text: I'd like to book a day tour.
Is there a discount for students?

questions.q: Hi there! What kind of tour are you interested in?
questions.sample: I'd like to book a day tour of the old town.

questions.q: Great choice! How many people will join?
questions.sample: There will be three of us.

questions.q: Perfect. Which day works best for you?
questions.sample: Saturday would be best.

questions.q: We have one at nine. By the way, do you prefer walking or riding a bus between places?
questions.q_ko: 9시에 하나 있어요. 그런데 장소 사이를 걷는 게 좋으세요, 버스를 타는 게 좋으세요?
questions.sample: I prefer walking, but my mother gets tired easily.
questions.sample_ko: 걷는 걸 좋아하지만 어머니가 쉽게 피곤해하세요.

questions.q: I understand. Do you have any food allergies we should know about for lunch?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 점심을 위해 알아야 할 음식 알레르기가 있나요?
questions.sample: Yes, my friend can't eat seafood.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 제 친구가 해산물을 못 먹어요.

closing: No problem, I'll note that. Your tour is booked, so see you on Saturday!
closing_ko: 문제없어요, 메모해 둘게요. 투어 예약됐어요, 토요일에 만나요!

title: Renting a Car
situation_ko: 렌터카 업체에서 차를 빌려요.

key_phrases.text: I'd like to rent a small car.

questions.q: Welcome! What kind of car are you looking for?
questions.sample: I'd like to rent a small car, something easy to drive.
questions.sample_ko: 운전하기 쉬운 작은 차를 빌리고 싶어요.

questions.q: We have a few. How long do you need it?
questions.sample: I need it for four days.

questions.q: OK. Do you have an international driver's license?
questions.sample: Yes, I have it right here.

questions.q: Thanks. Where are you planning to drive?
questions.sample: I'm going to drive along the coast and visit small towns.
questions.sample_ko: 해안을 따라 운전하며 작은 마을들을 방문할 거예요.

questions.q: Sounds beautiful! Would you like to add full insurance for peace of mind?
questions.q_ko: 아름답겠네요! 안심을 위해 종합 보험을 추가하시겠어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I think I should. How much is it?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 그래야 할 것 같아요. 얼마예요?

closing: It's ten dollars a day. Here are your keys. Drive safely and enjoy the coast!
closing_ko: 하루 10달러예요. 열쇠 여기 있어요. 안전 운전하시고 해안을 즐기세요!

title: Lost in the City
situation_ko: 복잡한 도시에서 길을 잃어 행인에게 도움을 청해요.

key_phrases.text: Could you show me on the map?
How long does it take on foot?

questions.q: Hi! You seem a bit confused. Can I help?
questions.sample: Yes, I think I'm lost. I'm looking for the art museum.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 길을 잃은 것 같아요. 미술관을 찾고 있어요.

questions.q: Oh, it's near the river. Do you have a map on your phone?
questions.q_ko: 아, 강 근처예요. 휴대폰에 지도 있으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, but the battery is low. Could you show me on the map?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 그런데 배터리가 거의 없어요. 지도에서 보여 주실 수 있어요?

questions.q: Sure, we are here, and the museum is there. Should I explain the way in detail?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요, 우리는 여기 있고 미술관은 저기예요. 길을 자세히 설명해 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, please. And how long does it take on foot?

questions.q: About fifteen minutes. How did you end up so far from your hotel?
questions.q_ko: 15분쯤 걸려요. 어쩌다 호텔에서 이렇게 멀리 오셨어요?
questions.sample: I followed a small street because it looked interesting, and then I got confused.
questions.sample_ko: 재미있어 보이는 작은 길을 따라갔다가 헷갈렸어요.

questions.q: That happens to everyone! Is there anything else you want to see around here?
questions.q_ko: 누구나 그래요! 이 근처에서 보고 싶은 다른 곳이 있나요?
questions.sample: I'd love to try some local food nearby.
questions.sample_ko: 근처에서 현지 음식을 먹어 보고 싶어요.

closing: There's a great noodle shop on the way. Good luck, and enjoy the museum!
closing_ko: 가는 길에 맛있는 국숫집이 있어요. 행운을 빌어요, 미술관 즐기세요!

title: Hotel Room Problem
situation_ko: 호텔 방에 문제가 있어 프런트에 말해요.

questions.q: Good evening. How can I help you?
questions.sample: I have a problem with my room. The air conditioner isn't working.
questions.sample_ko: 방에 문제가 있어요. 에어컨이 작동하지 않아요.

questions.q: I'm so sorry. Did you try the remote control?
questions.sample: Yes, I changed the batteries, but nothing happened.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 건전지도 바꿨는데 아무 일도 없었어요.

questions.q: I see. Would you like us to fix it, or would you prefer a different room?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 저희가 고쳐 드릴까요, 아니면 다른 방을 원하세요?
questions.sample: I'd prefer a different room, if that's possible.

questions.q: We have one on the fifth floor. Do you want a quiet room facing the garden?
questions.q_ko: 5층에 하나 있어요. 정원 쪽 조용한 방을 원하세요?
questions.sample: Yes, that would be great. The street was too noisy last night.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 좋아요. 어젯밤엔 길이 너무 시끄러웠어요.

questions.q: I apologize for that. Do you need help carrying your luggage?
questions.sample: Yes, please. I have two heavy suitcases.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 부탁해요. 무거운 가방이 두 개 있어요.

closing: Of course. A staff member will help you right away. Thank you for your patience!
closing_ko: 물론이죠. 직원이 바로 도와드릴 거예요. 기다려 주셔서 감사해요!

title: Using the Subway
situation_ko: 처음 가는 도시의 지하철역에서 표를 사는 방법을 물어요.

key_phrases.text: How do I buy a ticket?
Which line goes to the zoo?

questions.q: Hello! Can I help you with something?
questions.sample: Yes, how do I buy a ticket? This machine is confusing.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 표는 어떻게 사요? 이 기계가 헷갈려요.

questions.q: Just press this button. Where are you heading today?
questions.q_ko: 이 버튼만 누르세요. 오늘 어디로 가세요?
questions.sample: I want to go to the zoo. Which line goes there?
questions.sample_ko: 동물원에 가고 싶어요. 몇 호선이 거기로 가요?

questions.q: Take the green line. Do you want a single ticket or a day pass?
questions.sample: A day pass sounds better, because I'll go to several places.
questions.sample_ko: 여러 곳에 갈 거라 1일권이 나을 것 같아요.

questions.q: Good idea. Is that for just you, or are you with someone?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 혼자세요, 아니면 일행이 있나요?
questions.sample: I'm with my two kids, so we need three passes.
questions.sample_ko: 아이 둘과 함께라서 세 장이 필요해요.

questions.q: Kids will love the zoo! How old are they?
questions.q_ko: 아이들이 동물원을 좋아할 거예요! 몇 살이에요?
questions.sample: They are six and nine, and they love pandas.
questions.sample_ko: 여섯 살과 아홉 살이고, 판다를 좋아해요.

closing: The pandas are wonderful there. No transfer needed. Have a great day!
closing_ko: 거기 판다는 정말 멋져요. 환승은 필요 없어요. 좋은 하루 보내세요!

title: Visiting a Museum
situation_ko: 박물관 입구에서 표를 사고 관람에 대해 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: How long does the tour take?

questions.q: Welcome to the City Museum! How many tickets do you need?
questions.q_ko: 시립 박물관에 오신 걸 환영해요! 표가 몇 장 필요하세요?
questions.sample: Two adult tickets, please.

questions.q: That will be thirty dollars. Would you like an audio guide as well?
questions.sample: Yes, is there one in Korean?

questions.q: Yes, we do. What are you most interested in: history, art or science?
questions.q_ko: 네, 있어요. 역사, 미술, 과학 중에 뭐에 가장 관심이 있나요?
questions.sample: I'm mostly interested in history, especially ancient history.
questions.sample_ko: 주로 역사, 특히 고대사에 관심이 있어요.

questions.q: Then start with the second floor. How much time do you have today?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 2층부터 시작하세요. 오늘 시간이 얼마나 있으세요?
questions.sample: We have about two hours before lunch.

questions.q: That's enough for the main halls. Have you been to a museum like this before?
questions.q_ko: 주요 전시관을 보기엔 충분해요. 이런 박물관에 가 본 적 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I visited a big one in London last year.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 작년에 런던에서 큰 곳에 가 봤어요.

closing: Wonderful! Here are your tickets. Enjoy your visit!
closing_ko: 멋지네요! 표 여기 있어요. 즐거운 관람 되세요!

title: My Last Trip
situation_ko: 새로 사귄 친구가 가장 최근의 여행에 대해 물어봐요.
user_role: A traveler sharing a recent trip

key_phrases.text: I went to Jeju Island last month.
The best part was the food.

questions.q: Hey! Have you traveled anywhere recently?
questions.sample: Yes, I went to Jeju Island last month.

questions.q: Oh nice! Who did you go with?
questions.sample: I went with my two college friends.

questions.q: That sounds fun! What did you do there?
questions.sample: We rented a car, walked on the beach, and climbed a small hill.
questions.sample_ko: 차를 빌려서 해변을 걷고 작은 오름에 올랐어.

questions.q: I'd love to do that. What was the best part of the trip?
questions.q_ko: 나도 해 보고 싶다. 여행에서 가장 좋았던 건 뭐야?
questions.sample: The best part was the fresh seafood. It was amazing.
questions.sample_ko: 가장 좋았던 건 신선한 해산물이었어. 정말 굉장했어.

questions.q: Do you want to go back someday?
questions.sample: Definitely. Next time I'd like to stay longer.
questions.sample_ko: 당연하지. 다음엔 더 오래 머물고 싶어.

closing: It sounds like a perfect trip. Thanks for sharing it with me!
closing_ko: 완벽한 여행이었던 것 같아. 이야기해 줘서 고마워!

title: Planning a Weekend Trip
situation_ko: 친구와 함께 주말 여행 계획을 세워요.
ai_role: A friend planning a trip together
user_role: A friend planning a weekend getaway

key_phrases.text: How about going to the mountains?
We could leave early on Saturday.
I'd rather not spend too much.

questions.q: I really need a break. Where should we go this weekend?
questions.q_ko: 난 정말 쉬고 싶어. 이번 주말에 어디 갈까?
questions.sample: How about going to the mountains? It would be relaxing.
questions.sample_ko: 산에 가는 건 어때? 편히 쉴 수 있을 거야.

questions.q: Good idea! How should we get there?
questions.sample: We could take a train, because driving is tiring.

questions.q: Sounds good. When should we leave?
questions.sample: We could leave early on Saturday and come back Sunday evening.
questions.sample_ko: 토요일 일찍 출발해서 일요일 저녁에 돌아오면 돼.

questions.q: OK! What about the budget? How much do you want to spend?
questions.sample: I'd rather not spend too much, maybe two hundred dollars each.
questions.sample_ko: 너무 많이 쓰고 싶진 않아, 각자 200달러 정도?

questions.q: That works for me. What do you want to do once we're there?
questions.q_ko: 난 괜찮아. 거기 가면 뭘 하고 싶어?
questions.sample: I'd like to hike a little and relax at a hot spring.

closing: Perfect, that's a great plan. I'll look for a cozy place to stay!
closing_ko: 완벽해, 멋진 계획이야. 아늑한 숙소를 찾아볼게!

title: Reporting Lost Luggage
situation_ko: 비행 후 짐이 도착하지 않아 분실 신고를 해요.
user_role: A passenger whose luggage is lost

key_phrases.text: It has a red tag on the handle.

questions.q: Hello, I'm sorry for the trouble. What happened?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요, 불편을 드려 죄송해요. 무슨 일이세요?
questions.sample: My luggage didn't arrive. I waited at the carousel for an hour.
questions.sample_ko: 제 짐이 도착하지 않았어요. 한 시간 동안 수하물 컨베이어에서 기다렸어요.

questions.q: Let me help you. Can you describe your suitcase?
questions.sample: It's a medium blue suitcase with a red tag on the handle.
questions.sample_ko: 중간 크기의 파란 가방이고 손잡이에 빨간 태그가 있어요.

questions.q: Thanks. Is there anything valuable inside?
questions.sample: There's no jewelry, but my medicine and a few clothes are in it.
questions.sample_ko: 보석은 없지만 약과 옷 몇 벌이 들어 있어요.

questions.q: I understand. Where should we deliver it when we find it?
questions.sample: Please send it to my hotel. It's called the Harbor Inn.
questions.sample_ko: 제 호텔로 보내 주세요. 하버 인이에요.

questions.q: Will you be OK until then? Do you need money for basic things?
questions.q_ko: 그때까지 괜찮으시겠어요? 기본 용품을 살 비용이 필요하세요?
questions.sample: Yes, that would help. I need to buy some clothes and a toothbrush.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 도움이 될 것 같아요. 옷과 칫솔을 사야 해요.

closing: We'll give you a small allowance. We'll call you as soon as we find your bag.
closing_ko: 소액의 지원금을 드릴게요. 가방을 찾는 대로 전화드릴게요.

title: Arriving at a Host Family
situation_ko: 홈스테이 가족의 집에 처음 도착해서 인사를 나눠요.
user_role: A guest staying with a host family

questions.q: Welcome! Come on in. How was your flight?
questions.sample: It was long, but I'm fine. Thank you for having me.

questions.q: We're so happy to meet you. Are you hungry? We made dinner.
questions.q_ko: 만나서 정말 기뻐요. 배고파요? 저녁을 준비했어요.
questions.sample: Yes, a little. I don't eat spicy food, though.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 조금요. 그런데 매운 음식은 안 먹어요.

questions.q: No problem, it's a mild pasta. Is there any other food you can't eat?
questions.q_ko: 괜찮아요, 순한 파스타예요. 못 먹는 다른 음식이 있어요?
questions.sample: I'm allergic to peanuts, so please avoid them.

questions.q: Got it, thanks for telling us. What would you like to do during your stay?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요, 말해 줘서 고마워요. 머무는 동안 뭘 하고 싶어요?
questions.sample: I want to practice my English and see the local markets.
questions.sample_ko: 영어를 연습하고 현지 시장을 구경하고 싶어요.

questions.q: We'll help with that. Do you have any questions about the house?
questions.q_ko: 도와줄게요. 집에 대해 궁금한 게 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, what are the house rules? Like, what time should I come home?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 집 규칙이 뭐예요? 몇 시까지 들어와야 해요?

closing: Just text us if you're late. Now let me show you your room!
closing_ko: 늦으면 문자만 해 줘요. 이제 방을 보여 줄게요!

title: Camping Trip
situation_ko: 캠핑장 접수처에서 자리를 배정받고 이야기해요.
user_role: A camper arriving at the campground

key_phrases.text: We have a reservation for two nights.

questions.q: Hi, welcome to Pine Lake Camp! Do you have a reservation?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요, 파인 레이크 캠프에 오신 걸 환영해요! 예약하셨나요?
questions.sample: Yes, we have a reservation for two nights.

questions.q: I found it. Are you staying in a tent or a camper van?
questions.sample: We have a tent. It's our first time camping, actually.

questions.q: How exciting! Who are you here with?
questions.sample: I'm here with my husband and our dog.

questions.q: Dogs are welcome here. Do you plan on making a campfire?
questions.sample: Yes, can we make one? We want to cook marshmallows.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 피워도 되나요? 마시멜로를 구워 먹고 싶어요.

questions.q: Only in the fire pit, please. Is there anything else you need to know?
questions.q_ko: 화덕 안에서만 부탁해요. 다른 궁금한 점이 있나요?
questions.sample: Where are the showers, and is the water warm?

closing: They're by the lake, and the water is warm. Have a wonderful first camping trip!
closing_ko: 호수 옆에 있고 물은 따뜻해요. 첫 캠핑 즐겁게 보내세요!

title: On a Cruise Ship
situation_ko: 크루즈 배에서 승무원과 일정에 대해 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: What time do we arrive at the island?

questions.q: Good afternoon! How are you enjoying the cruise so far?
questions.sample: It's wonderful, but I get seasick easily, so I feel a little dizzy.
questions.sample_ko: 정말 좋은데 배멀미를 쉽게 해서 조금 어지러워요.

questions.q: Oh no, I'm sorry. Would you like some medicine or fresh air on the deck?
questions.q_ko: 어머, 안타깝네요. 약이나 갑판에서 바람을 쐬는 건 어때요?
questions.sample: Fresh air sounds good. Also, what time do we arrive at the island?
questions.sample_ko: 바람 쐬는 게 좋겠어요. 그리고 섬에는 몇 시에 도착해요?

questions.q: We arrive at nine tomorrow morning. What would you like to do there?
questions.q_ko: 내일 아침 9시에 도착해요. 거기서 뭘 하고 싶으세요?
questions.sample: I'd like to try snorkeling if the weather is nice.
questions.sample_ko: 날씨가 좋으면 스노클링을 해 보고 싶어요.

questions.q: That's popular! Are you traveling with your family?
questions.q_ko: 인기 있는 활동이에요! 가족과 함께 여행 중이세요?
questions.sample: Yes, with my parents. It's their anniversary trip.

questions.q: How lovely! Is there any activity on the ship you'd like to try tonight?
questions.q_ko: 멋지네요! 오늘 밤 배에서 해 보고 싶은 활동이 있나요?
questions.sample: Is there a show tonight? My parents love music.
questions.sample_ko: 오늘 밤 공연이 있나요? 부모님이 음악을 좋아하세요.

closing: Yes, a live band plays at eight. I'll reserve good seats for your family!
closing_ko: 네, 8시에 라이브 밴드가 연주해요. 가족분들을 위해 좋은 자리를 예약해 둘게요!

title: Customs Declaration
situation_ko: 공항 세관에서 가방 안의 물건에 대해 질문을 받아요.

key_phrases.text: These are gifts for my friends.
I bought it for personal use.

questions.q: Good afternoon. Where did you travel from today?
questions.sample: I flew in from Seoul, and I changed planes in Dubai.

questions.q: I see. Do you have anything to declare?
questions.sample: No, I have nothing to declare, just clothes and some snacks.
questions.sample_ko: 아니요, 신고할 건 없고 옷과 간식뿐이에요.

questions.q: OK. Can you open this bag, please? What's this box?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 이 가방을 열어 주시겠어요? 이 상자는 뭐예요?
questions.sample: Those are gifts for my friends. They're tea and some candy.

questions.q: No problem. Do you have more than ten thousand dollars in cash?
questions.q_ko: 문제없어요. 현금을 1만 달러 넘게 갖고 계세요?
questions.sample: No, I only have about three hundred dollars.

questions.q: Good. How long are you planning to stay in this country?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 이 나라에 얼마나 머무를 계획이세요?
questions.sample: About two weeks. I'm visiting my brother who lives here.

closing: Thank you for your cooperation. You're free to go. Enjoy your visit!
closing_ko: 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다. 가셔도 좋아요. 즐거운 방문 되세요!

title: Missed Flight
situation_ko: 비행기를 놓쳐서 항공사 카운터에서 다음 편을 알아봐요.
user_role: A passenger who missed a flight

key_phrases.text: Will I have to pay extra?

questions.q: Hello, how can I help you today?
questions.sample: I missed my flight to Rome. The traffic was terrible.
questions.sample_ko: 로마행 비행기를 놓쳤어요. 교통이 너무 막혔어요.

questions.q: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to travel today or tomorrow?
questions.q_ko: 안타깝네요. 오늘 가고 싶으세요, 내일 가고 싶으세요?
questions.sample: Today if possible. Is there another flight this evening?
questions.sample_ko: 가능하면 오늘이요. 오늘 저녁에 다른 비행기가 있나요?

questions.q: There's one at seven, but it has only a middle seat. Is that all right?
questions.sample: That's fine. Will I have to pay extra for changing the ticket?
questions.sample_ko: 괜찮아요. 표를 바꾸면 추가 요금을 내야 하나요?

questions.q: There's a change fee of fifty dollars. Does that work for you?
questions.sample: Yes, I'll pay it. I have an important meeting tomorrow.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 낼게요. 내일 중요한 회의가 있어요.

questions.q: I understand. Do you need to tell anyone about your late arrival?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 늦게 도착한다고 누구에게 알려야 하나요?
questions.sample: Yes, I need to call my hotel so they keep my room.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 호텔에 전화해서 방을 유지해 달라고 해야 해요.

closing: Good thinking. You're booked on the seven o'clock flight. Safe travels!
closing_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 7시 비행기로 예약됐어요. 안전한 여행 되세요!

title: Beach Vacation
situation_ko: 해변 리조트에서 휴가를 즐기는 계획에 대해 이야기해요.
user_role: A vacationer at a beach resort

key_phrases.text: Do I need to book in advance?

questions.q: Good morning! Are you enjoying your stay at the resort?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 아침이에요! 리조트에서 잘 지내고 계세요?
questions.sample: Yes, it's beautiful. The water is so clear.

questions.q: We're glad to hear that! What would you like to do today?
questions.sample: I'd like to try surfing, but I'm a complete beginner.
questions.sample_ko: 서핑을 해 보고 싶은데 완전 초보예요.

questions.q: No worries, we have lessons. Do you want a morning or an afternoon class?
questions.q_ko: 걱정 마세요, 강습이 있어요. 오전 수업이 좋으세요, 오후 수업이 좋으세요?
