closing_ko: 좋아요, 지금 처리해 드릴게요. 불편 드려 다시 한번 죄송합니다.

title: Exchanging a Sweater
situation_ko: 선물 받은 스웨터를 다른 색으로 교환하고 싶어요.

key_phrases.text: Can I exchange it for another color?

questions.q: Hello! What can I do for you?
questions.sample: I'd like to exchange this sweater. It was a gift.
questions.sample_ko: 이 스웨터를 교환하고 싶어요. 선물 받은 거예요.

questions.q: Of course. Is there something wrong with it?
questions.sample: No, it's just not my color. I'd like a gray one.
questions.sample_ko: 아니요, 제 색이 아니라서요. 회색이 좋아요.

questions.q: I understand. Do you have the gift receipt?
questions.sample: No, I don't. My friend lost it.

questions.q: That's okay, I can look it up by the tag. What size do you need?
questions.q_ko: 괜찮아요, 태그로 찾아볼 수 있어요. 사이즈는 어떻게 하시겠어요?
questions.sample: Medium is fine.

questions.q: We have a gray medium. Would you like to try it on first?
questions.q_ko: 회색 미디엄이 있어요. 먼저 입어 보시겠어요?
questions.sample: Yes, that would be great.

closing: Perfect, it's all set. Hope you enjoy the new one!
closing_ko: 좋아요, 다 됐어요. 새 걸 마음에 들어 하시길 바랄게요!

title: Choosing a Laptop
situation_ko: 전자제품 매장에서 새 노트북을 골라요.

key_phrases.text: I'm looking for a light laptop.
I'll use it mostly for work.

questions.q: Hi! Are you looking for something special today?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 오늘 특별히 찾는 게 있으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm looking for a new laptop.

questions.q: Great! What will you use it for?
questions.sample: Mostly for work, like emails and documents.
questions.sample_ko: 주로 이메일이나 문서 작업 같은 업무용이에요.

questions.q: Got it. Do you carry it around a lot, or does it stay at home?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 들고 다니는 일이 많으세요, 집에 두실 건가요?
questions.sample: I carry it every day, so it should be light.

questions.q: Then this one is perfect. What's your budget?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 이게 딱이에요. 예산은 어느 정도세요?
questions.sample: Around 1,000 dollars.

questions.q: This one is 950. Would you like to see how the keyboard feels?
questions.sample: Sure, I'd like to try it.

closing: Take your time. I'll be right here if you have questions.
closing_ko: 천천히 보세요. 궁금한 게 있으면 여기 있을게요.

title: Choosing a Phone Plan
situation_ko: 통신사 매장에서 새 요금제를 알아봐요.
user_role: A customer choosing a phone plan

key_phrases.text: How much data does this plan have?
I use a lot of data.

questions.q: Welcome! How can I help you today?
questions.sample: I want to change my phone plan.

questions.q: Sure. What's the problem with your current plan?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요. 지금 요금제에 무슨 문제가 있나요?
questions.sample: It's too expensive, and I don't use all the data.
questions.sample_ko: 너무 비싸고 데이터를 다 쓰지도 않아요.

questions.q: I see. How much data do you use in a month?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 한 달에 데이터를 얼마나 쓰세요?
questions.sample: About ten gigabytes, I think.

questions.q: Then a 15-gigabyte plan would be good. Do you watch a lot of videos?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 15기가 요금제가 좋겠네요. 동영상을 많이 보세요?
questions.sample: Sometimes, but mostly I use Wi-Fi at home.
questions.sample_ko: 가끔요, 하지만 대부분 집에서 와이파이를 써요.

questions.q: This plan is 30 dollars a month. Do you have any questions about it?
questions.q_ko: 이 요금제는 한 달에 30달러예요. 궁금한 점 있으세요?
questions.sample: Is there a contract?

closing: No contract at all. I'll set it up for you now.
closing_ko: 약정은 전혀 없어요. 지금 설정해 드릴게요.

title: Coloring Your Hair
situation_ko: 미용실에서 머리 염색을 상담해요.
user_role: A customer who wants to dye their hair

key_phrases.text: I want to dye my hair brown.
I don't want it too dark.

questions.q: Hi! What are we doing today?
questions.sample: I want to dye my hair a light brown.

questions.q: Nice! Have you dyed your hair before?
questions.sample: Yes, about six months ago.

questions.q: Okay. Is your scalp sensitive to hair dye at all?
questions.sample: A little. It gets itchy sometimes.

questions.q: Thanks for telling me. I'll use a gentle one. Do you want a cut too?
questions.q_ko: 말씀해 주셔서 감사해요. 순한 걸 쓸게요. 커트도 하실래요?
questions.sample: Yes, just a trim, please.

questions.q: Sure. It'll take about two hours. Is that okay with your schedule?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요. 두 시간쯤 걸려요. 일정 괜찮으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm free all afternoon.

closing: Perfect. Let's get started!
closing_ko: 좋아요. 시작해 볼게요!

title: Dry Cleaning a Stain
situation_ko: 세탁소에 얼룩진 재킷을 맡겨요.
user_role: A customer with a stained jacket

key_phrases.text: When can I pick it up?

questions.q: Hello! What do you have for us today?
questions.sample: I have this jacket. It has a coffee stain.

questions.q: Let me see. Where exactly is the stain?
questions.sample: It's here, on the sleeve.

questions.q: I see it. How long ago did it happen?
questions.sample: Two days ago.

questions.q: We'll try our best. Is there anything else you want cleaned?
questions.q_ko: 최선을 다해 볼게요. 세탁할 다른 건 없으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, these two shirts, please.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 이 셔츠 두 장도 부탁해요.

questions.q: Okay. When do you need everything by?
questions.sample: By Friday, if possible.

closing: No problem. It'll be ready on Thursday.
closing_ko: 문제없어요. 목요일에 준비될 거예요.

title: Strange Car Noise
situation_ko: 정비소에서 차에서 나는 이상한 소리를 설명해요.

key_phrases.text: My car is making a strange noise.

questions.q: Hi there. What seems to be the problem?
questions.sample: My car is making a strange noise.

questions.q: What kind of noise is it?
questions.sample: It's a loud squeaking sound.

questions.q: When do you hear it?
questions.sample: Only when I brake.

questions.q: It could be the brake pads. How long has this been going on?
questions.q_ko: 브레이크 패드일 수 있어요. 얼마나 됐어요?
questions.sample: For about a week.

questions.q: I'll take a look. Do you need the car back today?
questions.sample: Yes, I need it by five o'clock if possible.

closing: Okay, I'll check it right away and call you with the price.
closing_ko: 네, 바로 확인하고 가격을 전화로 알려 드릴게요.

title: Late Package
situation_ko: 고객센터에 전화해서 늦게 오는 택배를 확인해요.
user_role: A customer waiting for a package

key_phrases.ko: 배송 조회를 해 주실 수 있나요?

questions.q: Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
questions.sample: My package hasn't arrived yet, and it's already a week late.
questions.sample_ko: 택배가 아직 안 왔어요. 벌써 일주일이나 늦었어요.

questions.q: I'm sorry about that. Could I have your order number?
questions.sample: Sure, it's 4521.

questions.q: Thank you. And what's the name on the order?
questions.sample: It's Jisoo Park.

questions.q: I see it was sent to the wrong address. Is your address still on Maple Street?
questions.q_ko: 잘못된 주소로 보내졌네요. 주소가 아직 메이플 스트리트가 맞나요?
questions.sample: Yes, but the apartment number is 302.

questions.q: Thank you. Would you like us to resend it or give you a refund?
questions.q_ko: 감사합니다. 다시 보내 드릴까요, 환불해 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Please resend it as soon as possible.
questions.sample_ko: 가능한 한 빨리 다시 보내 주세요.

closing: Understood. We'll send it by express delivery today.
closing_ko: 알겠습니다. 오늘 빠른 배송으로 보내 드릴게요.

title: Wrong Item Delivered
situation_ko: 온라인으로 주문한 신발 대신 다른 물건이 와서 문의해요.
ai_role: An online store chat support agent
user_role: A customer who received the wrong item

key_phrases.text: Do I have to pay for the return?

questions.q: Hi, thanks for contacting us. What's the issue?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요, 문의해 주셔서 감사합니다. 어떤 문제인가요?
questions.sample: I received the wrong item.

questions.q: Oh no, I'm sorry. What did you order?
questions.sample: I ordered black sneakers, size 260.

questions.q: And what did you get instead?
questions.sample: I got white sandals, size 240.

questions.q: I apologize. Could you send me a photo of the box?
questions.sample: Sure, I'll send it now.

questions.q: Thank you. Do you want the right sneakers sent, or would you prefer your money back?
questions.q_ko: 감사합니다. 맞는 운동화를 보내 드릴까요, 환불을 원하세요?
questions.sample: I'd like the right sneakers, please. Do I have to pay for the return?
questions.sample_ko: 맞는 운동화로 받고 싶어요. 반품 비용을 내야 하나요?

closing: No, it's free of charge. We'll send a pickup label by email.
closing_ko: 아니요, 무료예요. 이메일로 수거 라벨을 보내 드릴게요.

title: Signing Up at a Gym
situation_ko: 헬스장에 처음 와서 회원 가입을 상담해요.
user_role: A person who wants to join a gym

questions.q: Welcome to the gym! How can I help you?
questions.q_ko: 헬스장에 오신 걸 환영해요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
questions.sample: I'd like to sign up for a membership.

questions.q: Great! Have you worked out at a gym before?
questions.sample: Yes, but I stopped two years ago.

questions.q: I see. What are your goals?
questions.sample: I want to lose some weight and get stronger.

questions.q: Good goals. When do you usually plan to come?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 목표네요. 보통 언제 오실 계획이세요?
questions.sample: After work, around seven in the evening.

questions.q: We have a three-month plan and a one-year plan. Which one interests you?
questions.q_ko: 3개월 회원권과 1년 회원권이 있어요. 어느 쪽이 끌리세요?
questions.sample: The three-month plan, so I can try it first.

closing: Sounds good. Let me get the forms ready for you.
closing_ko: 좋아요. 서류를 준비해 드릴게요.

title: Opening an Account at the Bank Counter
situation_ko: 은행에서 새 계좌를 만들어요.

key_phrases.text: I'd like to open a bank account.

questions.q: Good morning. How can I help you?
questions.sample: I'd like to open a bank account.

questions.q: Of course. Is this your first account with us?
questions.q_ko: 물론이죠. 저희 은행에서 처음 만드시는 건가요?
questions.sample: Yes, it's my first one here.

questions.q: Do you want a checking account or a savings account?
questions.q_ko: 입출금 계좌를 원하세요, 저축 계좌를 원하세요?
questions.sample: A checking account, for everyday use.

questions.q: Okay. Do you have your ID with you?
questions.sample: Yes, here's my ID.

questions.q: Thank you. Do you have any questions about the account?
questions.q_ko: 감사합니다. 계좌에 대해 궁금한 게 있으세요?
questions.sample: Is there a monthly fee?

closing: No fee if you keep 500 dollars in the account. Let's finish the paperwork.
closing_ko: 계좌에 500달러를 유지하시면 수수료는 없어요. 서류를 마무리해 볼게요.

title: Finding an Apartment
situation_ko: 부동산에서 월세 아파트를 찾아요.
user_role: A person looking for an apartment to rent

key_phrases.text: I'm looking for a one-bedroom apartment.
It should be near the subway.

questions.q: Hello! What kind of place are you looking for?
questions.sample: I'm looking for a one-bedroom apartment.

questions.q: Sure. Which area do you prefer?
questions.sample: Somewhere near the subway, because I commute to work.

questions.q: That makes sense. What's your monthly budget?
questions.sample: Around 800 dollars a month.

questions.q: Okay. Do you have pets or need parking?
questions.sample: No pets, but I have a small car.

questions.q: I have two places to show you. When are you free to visit?
questions.q_ko: 보여 드릴 곳이 두 군데 있어요. 언제 방문하실 수 있으세요?
questions.sample: This Saturday morning would be great.

closing: Perfect, I'll arrange the viewings for Saturday.
closing_ko: 좋아요, 토요일에 볼 수 있게 준비해 둘게요.

title: Buying a Sofa
situation_ko: 가구점에서 새 소파를 골라요.

key_phrases.text: I need a sofa for a small living room.

questions.q: Hi! Looking for anything in particular?
questions.sample: Yes, I need a sofa for my living room.

questions.q: Nice! How big is your living room?
questions.sample: It's quite small, about three meters wide.

questions.q: Then a two-seater would work well. What color do you like?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 2인용이 잘 맞겠네요. 무슨 색을 좋아하세요?
questions.sample: Something light, like beige or gray.

questions.q: This gray one is popular. Would you like to sit on it?
questions.q_ko: 이 회색이 인기가 많아요. 앉아 보시겠어요?
questions.sample: Sure. It's comfortable, I like it.

questions.q: Great! Do you need us to deliver it?
questions.sample: Yes, please. Can you bring it this weekend?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 부탁해요. 이번 주말에 가져다주실 수 있나요?

closing: We can do Saturday afternoon. Thanks for choosing us!
closing_ko: 토요일 오후에 가능해요. 저희를 선택해 주셔서 감사합니다!

title: A Birthday Gift for a Friend
situation_ko: 선물 가게에서 친구 생일 선물을 골라요.
user_role: A customer looking for a birthday gift

key_phrases.text: I need a birthday gift for my friend.
I'm not sure what to get.

questions.q: Hi! Can I help you find something?
questions.sample: Yes, I need a birthday gift for my friend, but I'm not sure what to get.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 친구 생일 선물이 필요한데 뭘 사야 할지 모르겠어요.

questions.q: No problem! What does your friend like to do?
questions.q_ko: 괜찮아요! 친구분은 뭘 하는 걸 좋아하세요?
questions.sample: She likes cooking and baking.

questions.q: Lovely! What's your budget?
questions.sample: About thirty dollars.

questions.q: How about this nice apron or this set of baking tools?
questions.q_ko: 이 멋진 앞치마나 베이킹 도구 세트는 어때요?
questions.sample: I like the apron. Does it come in blue?

questions.q: Yes, we do. Would you like it gift-wrapped?
questions.sample: Yes, please. With a small card.

closing: It'll be ready in a few minutes. I'm sure she'll love it!
closing_ko: 몇 분이면 준비돼요. 분명 좋아할 거예요!

title: Winter Sale Coat
situation_ko: 세일 기간에 겨울 코트를 사려고 해요.
user_role: A shopper looking for a winter coat

key_phrases.text: How much is it after the discount?
Can I get a better price?
key_phrases.ko: 조금 더 깎아 주실 수 있어요?

questions.q: Hello! Our winter sale is on. Looking for anything?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 겨울 세일 중이에요. 찾으시는 게 있나요?
questions.sample: Yes, I need a warm winter coat.

questions.q: We have lots! Do you like long coats or short ones?
questions.q_ko: 많이 있어요! 긴 코트와 짧은 코트 중 뭐가 좋으세요?
questions.sample: I prefer long ones because they're warmer.

questions.q: Try this black one. How does it fit?
questions.q_ko: 이 검은색을 입어 보세요. 잘 맞나요?
questions.sample: It fits well, but the sleeves are a little long.

questions.q: We can shorten them for free. Do you like the style?
questions.q_ko: 무료로 줄여 드릴 수 있어요. 스타일은 마음에 드세요?
questions.sample: Yes, I do. Is it on sale?

questions.q: It's thirty percent off, so 140 dollars. Would you like to take it?
questions.sample: Yes, I'll take it.

closing: Wonderful! I'll mark the sleeves for you.
closing_ko: 좋아요! 소매 줄일 곳을 표시해 드릴게요.

title: Allergy Medicine
situation_ko: 약국에서 알레르기약을 상담하고 사요.

questions.q: Hi! What can I help you with?
questions.sample: I think I have allergies. My eyes are itchy.

questions.q: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have any other symptoms?
questions.sample: Yes, I sneeze a lot and my nose is runny.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 재채기를 많이 하고 콧물도 나요.

questions.q: Is it worse at certain times of the day?
questions.q_ko: 하루 중 특정 시간에 더 심해지나요?
questions.sample: It's worse in the morning, when I go outside.

questions.q: It might be pollen. Are you taking any other medicine now?
questions.q_ko: 꽃가루일 수 있어요. 지금 다른 약을 드시고 있나요?
questions.sample: No, nothing right now.

questions.q: This tablet works well. Do you have any questions?
questions.q_ko: 이 알약이 잘 들어요. 궁금한 점 있으세요?
questions.sample: Does it make me sleepy? I have to drive to work.

closing: This one is non-drowsy, so it's safe for driving.
closing_ko: 이건 졸리지 않은 약이라 운전하셔도 안전해요.

title: Repairing Old Shoes
situation_ko: 수선 가게에 낡은 구두의 굽을 고쳐 달라고 맡겨요.

questions.q: Hello! What can I do for you?
questions.sample: Can you fix these shoes? The heel is worn out.
questions.sample_ko: 이 구두 고쳐 주실 수 있어요? 굽이 닳았어요.

questions.q: Let me see. Oh, they're nice shoes. Have you had them long?
questions.q_ko: 어디 볼게요. 아, 좋은 구두네요. 오래 신으셨어요?
questions.sample: Yes, about five years. They're very comfortable.

questions.q: That's worth fixing. Do you want me to polish them too?
questions.sample: Yes, please. They look dull.

questions.q: Sure. It'll take about two days. Is that all right?
questions.sample: That's fine. How much will it be?

questions.q: Fifteen dollars for both. What name should I write on the ticket?
questions.q_ko: 둘 다 해서 15달러예요. 번호표에 이름을 뭐라고 적을까요?
questions.sample: Please write Kim.

closing: All set. Come back on Thursday to pick them up.
closing_ko: 다 됐어요. 목요일에 찾으러 오세요.

title: Buying a Bicycle
situation_ko: 자전거 가게에서 출퇴근용 자전거를 골라요.
user_role: A customer buying a commuter bike

key_phrases.text: I'd like to ride to work.
Can I take it for a test ride?
Does it come with a lock?

questions.q: Hi! Looking for a bike?
questions.sample: Yes, I'd like to ride to work.

questions.q: Great idea! How far is your commute?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 생각이에요! 출근 거리가 얼마나 돼요?
questions.sample: About eight kilometers each way.

questions.q: That's a nice ride. Are there many hills on your way?
questions.q_ko: 괜찮은 거리네요. 가는 길에 언덕이 많아요?
questions.sample: A few, so I'd like some gears.
questions.sample_ko: 몇 군데 있어서 기어가 있으면 좋겠어요.

questions.q: This model has seven gears. Would you like to test ride it?
questions.sample: Yes, please. Can I ride around the block?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 부탁해요. 한 블록 돌아봐도 될까요?

questions.q: Of course. How was it?
questions.sample: It felt smooth. Does it come with a lock?

closing: Yes, a lock and a helmet are included. Let's go ring you up!
closing_ko: 네, 자물쇠와 헬멧이 포함이에요. 계산하러 가요!

title: Hemming Pants
situation_ko: 수선집에서 바지 기장을 줄여요.
user_role: A customer with pants that are too long

questions.q: Hello! What do you need today?
questions.sample: These pants are too long. Could you shorten them?
questions.sample_ko: 이 바지가 너무 길어요. 줄여 주실 수 있어요?

questions.q: Sure. Could you try them on so I can mark them?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요. 표시할 수 있게 입어 보시겠어요?
questions.sample: Okay. I'll wear these shoes with them.

questions.q: Perfect. Do you want them to touch the shoes, or a bit above?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 신발에 닿게 할까요, 조금 위로 할까요?
questions.sample: A little above the shoes, please.
questions.sample_ko: 신발 위로 조금 올라오게 해 주세요.

questions.q: Got it. Is there anything else you need fixed?
questions.sample: Yes, one button is loose on this shirt.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 이 셔츠 단추 하나가 헐거워요.

questions.q: No problem. When do you need them?
questions.sample: I need them by Saturday, if possible.

closing: Friday afternoon should work. See you then!
closing_ko: 금요일 오후면 될 거예요. 그때 봬요!

title: New Glasses
situation_ko: 안경점에서 새 안경을 맞춰요.
user_role: A customer who needs new glasses

questions.q: Hi! How can I help you today?
questions.sample: I need new glasses. My old ones are broken.
questions.sample_ko: 새 안경이 필요해요. 예전 건 부러졌어요.

questions.q: Oh, I'm sorry. When did you last have your eyes tested?
questions.q_ko: 아, 안타깝네요. 마지막으로 시력 검사를 받은 게 언제예요?
questions.sample: About two years ago.

questions.q: We should test them again. Do you have trouble with distance or reading?
questions.q_ko: 다시 검사해 보는 게 좋겠어요. 먼 곳이 불편하세요, 읽을 때가 불편하세요?
questions.sample: Mostly seeing far away, like street signs.
questions.sample_ko: 주로 도로 표지판 같은 먼 곳이 안 보여요.

questions.q: Okay. What kind of frames do you like?
questions.sample: Light, thin metal ones, please.

questions.q: Good choice. Do you want thin lenses or standard ones?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 선택이에요. 얇은 렌즈로 할까요, 일반으로 할까요?
questions.sample: Thin lenses, because my eyes are quite bad.
questions.sample_ko: 눈이 많이 나빠서 얇은 렌즈로 할게요.

closing: They'll be ready in about a week. We'll text you.
closing_ko: 일주일쯤 후에 준비돼요. 문자 드릴게요.

title: Disputing a Repair Estimate
situation_ko: 정비소에서 생각보다 높은 수리 견적에 대해 이야기해요.
ai_role: A service manager at a car repair shop
user_role: A car owner questioning an estimate

key_phrases.text: Could you break down the cost for me?
key_phrases.ko: 비용을 항목별로 설명해 주실 수 있어요?

questions.q: Thanks for waiting. The repair will cost around 900 dollars. How does that sound?
questions.q_ko: 기다려 주셔서 감사합니다. 수리비가 900달러쯤 나와요. 어떠세요?
questions.sample: That's higher than I expected. Could you break down the cost for me?
questions.sample_ko: 생각보다 높네요. 비용을 항목별로 설명해 주실 수 있어요?

questions.q: Sure. It's 500 for parts and 400 for labor. Is there a part you want to know more about?
questions.q_ko: 그럼요. 부품이 500달러, 인건비가 400달러예요. 더 알고 싶은 부품이 있으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, why does the part cost so much? Is there a cheaper option?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 부품이 왜 그렇게 비싸요? 더 저렴한 선택지는 없나요?

questions.q: We can use a non-original part, which is cheaper. Would you be comfortable with that?
questions.q_ko: 순정이 아닌 부품을 쓰면 더 저렴해요. 그래도 괜찮으실까요?
questions.sample: Maybe, if it's reliable. Does it come with a warranty?

questions.q: It has a one-year warranty. Do you think you'd like to go ahead today?
questions.sample: I'd like to think about it, and maybe get a second opinion.
questions.sample_ko: 생각해 보고 다른 곳 의견도 들어보고 싶어요.

questions.q: That's fair. How urgent is the repair for you?
questions.sample: I can wait a couple of days, but I need the car for work next week.
questions.sample_ko: 며칠은 기다릴 수 있지만 다음 주에 출근하려면 차가 필요해요.

closing: No problem. Just let me know by Wednesday and I'll hold the price for you.
closing_ko: 괜찮아요. 수요일까지만 알려 주시면 그 가격으로 유지해 드릴게요.

title: Canceling a Gym Membership
situation_ko: 이사 때문에 헬스장 회원권을 해지하려고 해요.
user_role: A member who wants to cancel

key_phrases.text: I'd like to cancel my membership.

questions.q: Hi, what can I help you with?
questions.sample: I'd like to cancel my membership because I'm moving to another city.
questions.sample_ko: 다른 도시로 이사해서 회원권을 해지하고 싶어요.

questions.q: I'm sorry to hear that. When are you moving?
questions.sample: At the end of next month.

questions.q: I see. Have you enjoyed your time here?
questions.sample: Yes, very much. The trainers were helpful and the equipment was always clean.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 아주 좋았어요. 트레이너분들이 도움이 되고 기구도 늘 깨끗했어요.

questions.q: Thank you. Your plan has four months left. Would you consider transferring it to someone else?
questions.q_ko: 감사합니다. 회원권이 4개월 남았어요. 다른 사람에게 양도하는 건 고려해 보셨나요?
questions.sample: That's a good idea. Can a friend take it over without paying extra?
questions.sample_ko: 좋은 생각이네요. 친구가 추가 비용 없이 이어받을 수 있나요?

questions.q: Yes, there's only a small transfer fee. Or would you prefer a partial refund instead?
questions.q_ko: 네, 소액의 양도 수수료만 있어요. 아니면 일부 환불을 원하세요?
questions.sample: If a friend can take it, that would be better. Otherwise, I'd like to know the refund amount.
questions.sample_ko: 친구가 이어받을 수 있으면 그게 더 좋아요. 아니면 환불 금액을 알고 싶어요.

closing: Understood. Let me know your friend's name and I'll prepare the paperwork.
closing_ko: 알겠어요. 친구분 성함을 알려 주시면 서류를 준비할게요.

title: Comparing Internet Plans
situation_ko: 인터넷 회사 상담원과 여러 상품을 비교해요.

key_phrases.text: What's the difference between these two plans?
I work from home, so speed matters.
I'd rather pay a bit more for a stable connection.
key_phrases.ko: 돈을 조금 더 내더라도 안정적인 연결이 좋아요.

questions.q: Hello! What are you looking for in an internet plan?
questions.sample: I work from home, so I need a fast and stable connection.
questions.sample_ko: 재택근무를 해서 빠르고 안정적인 연결이 필요해요.

questions.q: That makes sense. Do you often join video meetings or upload large files?
questions.q_ko: 그렇겠네요. 화상 회의를 자주 하거나 큰 파일을 올리나요?
questions.sample: Yes, I have video meetings almost every day, and sometimes I upload large design files.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 거의 매일 화상 회의를 하고 가끔 큰 디자인 파일을 올려요.

questions.q: Then I'd recommend our gigabit plan. How many people share the connection?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 기가비트 상품을 추천해요. 몇 명이 같이 쓰세요?
questions.sample: Just me and my partner, but we both use it all day.
questions.sample_ko: 저와 파트너뿐이지만 둘 다 하루 종일 써요.

questions.q: The gigabit plan is 55 a month, and the basic one is 35. Which seems better to you?
questions.q_ko: 기가비트는 한 달 55달러, 기본은 35달러예요. 어느 쪽이 나아 보이세요?
questions.sample: I'd rather pay a bit more for something stable, since slow internet affects my work.
questions.sample_ko: 인터넷이 느리면 일에 지장이 있으니 조금 더 내더라도 안정적인 게 좋아요.

questions.q: Fair enough. Would you like a one-year contract for a discount, or monthly with no commitment?
questions.q_ko: 그렇죠. 할인되는 1년 약정이 좋으세요, 약정 없는 월 단위가 좋으세요?
questions.sample: I'd go for the one-year contract if the discount is significant.

closing: The discount is 15 percent, so that's a good deal. I'll prepare the order.
closing_ko: 15% 할인이라서 괜찮은 조건이에요. 주문서를 준비할게요.

title: Faulty Washing Machine
situation_ko: 새로 배송받은 세탁기가 제대로 작동하지 않아 항의해요.
ai_role: A customer service manager at an appliance store

key_phrases.text: I'm afraid there's a problem with my order.
I'd like it fixed or replaced as soon as possible.
key_phrases.ko: 가능한 한 빨리 수리나 교체를 해 주세요.

key_phrases.text: This isn't what I expected for the price.

questions.q: Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
questions.sample: I'm afraid the washing machine you delivered doesn't work properly.
questions.sample_ko: 배송해 주신 세탁기가 제대로 작동하지 않아요.

questions.q: I'm sorry to hear that. What exactly is happening?
questions.sample: It stops in the middle of the cycle and shows an error code.
questions.sample_ko: 세탁 도중에 멈추고 오류 코드가 떠요.

questions.q: I see. Have you tried restarting it or checking the water supply?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 재시작하거나 급수 상태를 확인해 보셨어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I did both, and it didn't help. This isn't what I expected for the price.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 둘 다 해 봤는데 소용없었어요. 가격에 비해 기대에 못 미쳐요.

questions.q: Understandable. Would you prefer a repair visit or a full replacement?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 수리 방문이 좋으세요, 전체 교체가 좋으세요?
questions.sample: I'd prefer a replacement, since it's brand new and already broken.
questions.sample_ko: 새 제품인데 벌써 고장 났으니 교체를 원해요.

questions.q: We can arrange that. When would be a convenient time for the delivery?
questions.q_ko: 그렇게 준비할 수 있어요. 배송은 언제가 편하세요?
questions.sample: Any weekday after six o'clock works, since I'm at work during the day.
questions.sample_ko: 낮에는 일해서 평일 6시 이후면 언제든 괜찮아요.

closing: We'll schedule it this week and take the old one away at the same time. Thank you for your patience.
closing_ko: 이번 주에 일정을 잡고 이전 제품도 같이 가져갈게요. 기다려 주셔서 감사합니다.

title: Rent or Buy a Home
situation_ko: 부동산 중개인과 집을 사는 게 나은지 임대가 나은지 이야기해요.
user_role: A client deciding whether to rent or buy

key_phrases.text: I'm not sure if I'm ready to buy.
The main advantage of renting is flexibility.
In the long run, buying might be cheaper.
key_phrases.ko: 장기적으로는 사는 게 더 쌀 수도 있어요.

questions.q: Welcome! Are you thinking about renting or buying a home?
questions.q_ko: 어서 오세요! 집을 임대할지 살지 고민 중이세요?
questions.sample: I can't decide. I'm not sure if I'm ready to buy yet.
questions.sample_ko: 결정을 못 했어요. 아직 살 준비가 됐는지 모르겠어요.

questions.q: That's a big decision. What worries you most about buying?
questions.q_ko: 큰 결정이죠. 사는 것에 대해 가장 걱정되는 게 뭐예요?
questions.sample: The loan. I'm worried about paying it back for thirty years.

questions.q: Many people feel that way. What do you like about renting?
questions.q_ko: 많은 분이 그렇게 느껴요. 임대의 어떤 점이 좋으세요?
questions.sample: It's flexible. If my job changes, I can move easily.
questions.sample_ko: 유연해서요. 직장이 바뀌면 쉽게 이사할 수 있어요.

questions.q: True. How long do you think you'll stay in this city?
questions.q_ko: 맞아요. 이 도시에 얼마나 머물 것 같으세요?
questions.sample: Probably at least five years, so buying might be cheaper in the long run.
questions.sample_ko: 적어도 5년은 있을 것 같아서 장기적으로는 사는 게 더 쌀 수도 있겠네요.

questions.q: That's a good point. Would you like me to show you both a rental and a home for sale?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 임대 매물과 매매 매물을 둘 다 보여 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, that would help me compare them properly.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 제대로 비교하는 데 도움이 될 거예요.

closing: Great, I'll put together a short list of both. We'll find what suits you best.
closing_ko: 좋아요, 두 가지 모두 간단한 목록을 만들어 놓을게요. 가장 잘 맞는 걸 찾아봐요.

title: Online vs In-Store Shopping
situation_ko: 매장 직원과 온라인 쇼핑과 매장 쇼핑 중 어느 쪽이 나은지 이야기해요.
ai_role: A friendly shop assistant who likes chatting

key_phrases.text: I prefer shopping online because it's convenient.
The downside is that I can't try things on.
key_phrases.ko: 단점은 입어 볼 수 없다는 거예요.

key_phrases.text: It depends on what I'm buying.

questions.q: Hi! I see you're browsing. Do you usually shop in stores or online?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 둘러보고 계시네요. 보통 매장에서 쇼핑하세요, 온라인으로 하세요?
questions.sample: I mostly shop online because it's convenient and I can compare prices.
questions.sample_ko: 편리하고 가격 비교도 할 수 있어서 대부분 온라인으로 해요.

questions.q: That makes sense. Is there anything you don't like about online shopping?
questions.q_ko: 그렇겠네요. 온라인 쇼핑에서 마음에 안 드는 점이 있어요?
questions.sample: The downside is that I can't try things on, so I sometimes have to return them.
questions.sample_ko: 단점은 입어 볼 수 없어서 가끔 반품해야 한다는 거예요.

questions.q: I can see that. So why did you come to the store today?
questions.q_ko: 그럴 수 있겠어요. 그럼 오늘은 왜 매장에 오셨어요?
questions.sample: I wanted to find the right size for a jacket before ordering a different color online.
questions.sample_ko: 온라인에서 다른 색을 주문하기 전에 재킷 사이즈를 확인하고 싶었어요.

questions.q: Smart! Do you think stores will disappear one day?
questions.q_ko: 똑똑하시네요! 언젠가 매장이 사라질 거라고 생각하세요?
questions.sample: I don't think so. People like seeing and touching things, and shopping can be a social activity.
questions.sample_ko: 그렇게 생각하지 않아요. 사람들은 직접 보고 만지는 걸 좋아하고 쇼핑은 사교 활동이 될 수도 있으니까요.

questions.q: Good point. So if you had to choose one, which would you pick?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 하나만 고른다면 어느 쪽을 고르시겠어요?
questions.sample: It depends on what I'm buying. For clothes, I'd choose stores, and for everything else, online.
questions.sample_ko: 무엇을 사느냐에 따라 달라요. 옷은 매장, 나머지는 온라인을 고를 거예요.

closing: That's a very balanced view. Thanks for chatting, and enjoy your shopping!
closing_ko: 아주 균형 잡힌 생각이네요. 이야기 즐거웠어요, 즐거운 쇼핑 하세요!

title: TV Warranty Claim
situation_ko: 보증 기간 안에 고장 난 TV의 수리를 요청해요.
user_role: A customer with a broken TV

key_phrases.text: It should still be under warranty.
The screen went black all of a sudden.

questions.q: Thank you for contacting warranty service. What's wrong with your product?
questions.q_ko: 보증 서비스에 연락 주셔서 감사합니다. 제품에 어떤 문제가 있나요?
questions.sample: My TV screen went black all of a sudden, but I can still hear the sound.
questions.sample_ko: TV 화면이 갑자기 꺼졌는데 소리는 들려요.

questions.q: I see. When did you buy it?
questions.sample: I bought it last November, so it should still be under warranty.
questions.sample_ko: 작년 11월에 샀으니 아직 보증 기간일 거예요.

questions.q: Let me check. Yes, you have two years. Has the TV been dropped or had any water damage?
questions.q_ko: 확인해 볼게요. 네, 2년 보증이에요. TV를 떨어뜨리거나 물에 젖은 적이 있나요?
questions.sample: No, nothing like that. It was on the wall the whole time.
questions.sample_ko: 아니요, 그런 적 없어요. 계속 벽에 걸려 있었어요.

questions.q: Good. We'd send a technician. Is anyone home on weekdays?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 기사님을 보내 드릴게요. 평일에 집에 누가 있나요?
questions.sample: I'm out until six, so could he come in the evening or on Saturday?
questions.sample_ko: 6시까지 외출이라, 저녁이나 토요일에 오시면 안 될까요?

questions.q: Saturday morning is possible. If it can't be fixed, would you want a replacement or a refund?
questions.q_ko: 토요일 오전이 가능해요. 수리가 안 되면 교체와 환불 중 어느 쪽을 원하세요?
questions.sample: A replacement, please, as long as it's the same model or better.
questions.sample_ko: 같은 모델이거나 더 좋은 거라면 교체로 해 주세요.

closing: Understood. I'll book the technician for Saturday morning and send you a confirmation.
closing_ko: 알겠습니다. 토요일 오전으로 기사님 예약하고 확인 문자 보내 드릴게요.

title: Return Without a Receipt
situation_ko: 영수증을 잃어버렸지만 구매한 물건을 반품하려고 해요.

key_phrases.text: I'm afraid I lost the receipt.
I paid with my credit card.

questions.q: Hi, what would you like to return today?
questions.sample: This blender. I haven't used it much, but it doesn't blend ice well.
questions.sample_ko: 이 믹서기요. 많이 쓰진 않았는데 얼음이 잘 안 갈려요.

questions.q: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
questions.sample: I'm afraid I lost it. But I paid with my credit card.
questions.sample_ko: 잃어버린 것 같아요. 하지만 신용카드로 결제했어요.

questions.q: That can help. Do you remember roughly when you bought it?
questions.q_ko: 도움이 될 거예요. 대략 언제 샀는지 기억나세요?
questions.sample: It was about three weeks ago, in the middle of the month.

questions.q: Our policy is store credit without a receipt, but we may find it in the system. Is store credit okay with you?
questions.q_ko: 저희 규정상 영수증이 없으면 매장 적립금인데, 시스템에서 찾아볼 수도 있어요. 적립금도 괜찮으세요?
questions.sample: Store credit would be fine, but I'd prefer a refund if you can find the purchase.
questions.sample_ko: 적립금도 괜찮지만 구매 내역을 찾을 수 있다면 환불이 더 좋아요.

questions.q: Let me search with your card. Is there anything else you want to exchange while you're here?
questions.q_ko: 카드로 검색해 볼게요. 온 김에 교환할 다른 게 있으세요?
questions.sample: No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.

closing: I found it! I'll refund it to your card right now.
closing_ko: 찾았어요! 지금 바로 카드로 환불해 드릴게요.

title: Buying a Used Car
situation_ko: 중고차 딜러와 차를 사는 것에 대해 이야기해요.
user_role: A buyer considering a used car

key_phrases.text: How many kilometers has it been driven?
Has it ever been in an accident?
I'd like to have a mechanic look at it first.

questions.q: Welcome! Are you looking for a particular type of car?
questions.sample: I need a small, reliable car for the city, nothing too expensive.
questions.sample_ko: 도심에서 탈 작고 믿을 만한 차가 필요해요. 너무 비싸지 않은 걸로요.

questions.q: We have a few. What's your budget?
questions.q_ko: 몇 대 있어요. 예산이 어떻게 되세요?
questions.sample: Up to ten thousand dollars, and I'd rather not spend more.
questions.sample_ko: 1만 달러까지고, 그 이상은 쓰고 싶지 않아요.

questions.q: This hatchback is nine thousand. What would you like to know about it?
questions.q_ko: 이 해치백은 9천 달러예요. 어떤 점이 궁금하세요?
questions.sample: How many kilometers has it been driven, and has it ever been in an accident?
questions.sample_ko: 주행거리가 얼마나 되고 사고 이력은 있나요?

questions.q: It has 60,000 kilometers and a clean history. Would you like a test drive?
questions.q_ko: 주행거리 6만 킬로미터에 이력은 깨끗해요. 시승해 보시겠어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I'd like that. I'd also like to have a mechanic look at it before I decide.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 좋아요. 결정하기 전에 정비사에게도 보여 주고 싶어요.

questions.q: That's reasonable. If everything checks out, would you want to negotiate the price?
questions.q_ko: 합리적이네요. 문제가 없다면 가격 협상을 해 보시겠어요?
questions.sample: Yes, if the mechanic finds anything, I'd expect a lower price.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 정비사가 뭔가 발견하면 가격을 깎아 주셨으면 해요.

closing: Fair enough. Take it for a spin and we'll talk afterward.
closing_ko: 좋아요. 시승해 보시고 나서 이야기해요.

title: Unknown Card Charge
situation_ko: 은행에 전화해서 모르는 카드 결제 내역을 신고해요.
user_role: A cardholder who sees a charge they don't recognize

questions.q: Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
questions.sample: I noticed a charge on my card that I don't recognize.
questions.sample_ko: 카드에 모르는 결제 내역이 있는 걸 발견했어요.

questions.q: I'm sorry. Can you tell me the amount and the date?
questions.sample: It's 230 dollars from an online store, on the fifth of this month.

questions.q: Did you make any online purchase around that time, or did someone else use your card?
questions.q_ko: 그 무렵에 온라인 구매를 하셨거나 다른 사람이 카드를 썼나요?
questions.sample: No, I never made that purchase, and my card has always been with me.
questions.sample_ko: 아니요, 그런 구매는 한 적 없고 카드는 늘 제가 갖고 있었어요.

questions.q: It may be fraud. Would you like me to block the card and send you a new one?
questions.q_ko: 사기일 수 있어요. 카드를 정지하고 새 카드를 보내 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, please block it right away. How long will the new card take?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 바로 정지해 주세요. 새 카드는 얼마나 걸려요?

questions.q: About five business days. Do you use this card for any automatic payments?
questions.q_ko: 영업일로 5일쯤이에요. 이 카드로 자동 결제 설정된 게 있으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, my phone bill and a streaming service, so I'll need to update those.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 휴대폰 요금과 스트리밍 서비스가 있어서 바꿔 놔야 해요.

closing: I've filed the dispute. You should hear back within ten days, and you won't be charged for the 230.
closing_ko: 이의 신청을 접수했어요. 10일 안에 결과를 알려 드리고 230달러는 청구되지 않을 거예요.

title: Choosing a Mattress
situation_ko: 침구 매장에서 허리에 좋은 매트리스를 골라요.

key_phrases.text: I've been having back pain lately.
I think a firmer mattress would suit me.

questions.q: Hi! Are you shopping for a new mattress?
questions.sample: Yes. I've been having back pain lately, and I think my old mattress is the reason.
questions.sample_ko: 네. 요즘 허리가 아픈데 낡은 매트리스 때문인 것 같아요.

questions.q: That's common. How old is your current mattress?
questions.q_ko: 흔한 일이에요. 지금 매트리스는 얼마나 됐어요?
questions.sample: More than ten years old. It sags in the middle.

questions.q: That's definitely time for a change. Do you sleep on your back, side, or stomach?
questions.q_ko: 확실히 바꿀 때네요. 바로 누워서 주무세요, 옆으로, 아니면 엎드려서요?
questions.sample: Mostly on my side, but sometimes on my back.
questions.sample_ko: 주로 옆으로 자고 가끔은 바로 누워서 자요.

questions.q: Then a medium-firm one would be best. Do you prefer something soft or firm?
questions.q_ko: 그럼 중간 정도로 단단한 게 좋아요. 부드러운 쪽이 좋으세요, 단단한 쪽이 좋으세요?
questions.sample: I think a firmer mattress would suit me better because of my back.
questions.sample_ko: 허리 때문에 단단한 쪽이 더 맞을 것 같아요.

questions.q: Good. Please lie down and try it. How does it feel, and would a trial period help you decide?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 누워서 써 보세요. 느낌이 어떻고, 체험 기간이 있으면 결정에 도움이 될까요?
questions.sample: It feels supportive. Yes, a trial period would help, since a few minutes isn't enough to know.
questions.sample_ko: 받쳐 주는 느낌이에요. 네, 몇 분으로는 알 수 없으니 체험 기간이 있으면 도움이 될 거예요.

closing: We offer a 90-day trial. You can return it if it doesn't work for you.
closing_ko: 90일 체험 기간이 있어요. 맞지 않으면 반품하실 수 있어요.

title: Canceling a Subscription
situation_ko: 더 이상 쓰지 않는 구독 서비스를 해지하려고 고객센터에 전화해요.
user_role: A subscriber who wants to cancel

key_phrases.text: I'd like to cancel before the next payment.
I'm not interested in the discount.

questions.q: Thanks for calling. How can I help you today?
questions.q_ko: 전화 주셔서 감사합니다. 오늘 어떻게 도와드릴까요?
questions.sample: I'd like to cancel my subscription, please.

questions.q: I'm sorry to see you go. May I ask why you want to cancel?
questions.sample: I barely use it anymore, and I've been trying to cut down on monthly costs.
questions.sample_ko: 요즘은 거의 안 쓰고 매달 나가는 비용을 줄이려고 하고 있어요.

questions.q: I understand. We can offer you 50 percent off for three months. Would that change your mind?
questions.q_ko: 이해해요. 3개월간 50% 할인을 해 드릴 수 있어요. 마음이 바뀌실까요?
questions.sample: Thanks, but I'm not interested in the discount. I'd rather just cancel.
questions.sample_ko: 감사하지만 할인에는 관심 없어요. 그냥 해지하고 싶어요.

questions.q: Understood. When is your next payment date?
questions.sample: I think it's on the 25th, so I'd like to cancel before then.
questions.sample_ko: 25일인 것 같아서 그 전에 해지하고 싶어요.

questions.q: I can do that now. Would you like me to send a confirmation to your email?
questions.q_ko: 지금 처리해 드릴 수 있어요. 이메일로 확인 메일을 보내 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, please. I want to be sure I won't be charged again.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 부탁해요. 다시 청구되지 않는지 확실히 하고 싶어요.

closing: Done. Your subscription ends today and you won't be charged again.
closing_ko: 처리됐어요. 오늘 구독이 종료되고 더 이상 청구되지 않을 거예요.

title: A Wedding Gift
situation_ko: 백화점에서 동료의 결혼 선물을 골라요.
user_role: A guest choosing a wedding gift

key_phrases.text: I'd like something useful for a new home.
key_phrases.ko: 신혼집에 쓸모 있는 걸 선물하고 싶어요.

key_phrases.text: I don't know them very well.
I'd rather give something practical than something flashy.
key_phrases.ko: 화려한 것보다 실용적인 걸 주고 싶어요.

questions.q: Good afternoon! Are you shopping for a special occasion?
questions.sample: Yes, my coworker is getting married next month, and I need a wedding gift.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 직장 동료가 다음 달에 결혼해서 결혼 선물이 필요해요.

questions.q: Congratulations to them! How well do you know the couple?
questions.q_ko: 축하드려요! 두 분을 얼마나 잘 아세요?
questions.sample: I don't know them very well, so I'm not sure what they would like.
questions.sample_ko: 그분들을 잘 몰라서 뭘 좋아할지 모르겠어요.

questions.q: In that case, practical gifts are safe. What's your budget?
questions.q_ko: 그런 경우엔 실용적인 선물이 무난해요. 예산이 얼마예요?
questions.sample: Around seventy dollars. I'd rather give something practical than something flashy.
questions.sample_ko: 70달러 정도요. 화려한 것보다 실용적인 걸 주고 싶어요.

questions.q: How about a nice set of towels, a tea set, or a cooking pot? Which one seems best?
questions.q_ko: 고급 수건 세트나 티 세트, 냄비는 어때요? 어느 게 좋아 보이세요?
questions.sample: The tea set is lovely. It feels special without being too personal.
questions.sample_ko: 티 세트가 예쁘네요. 너무 사적이지 않으면서 특별한 느낌이 있어요.

questions.q: Great choice. Should I include a gift receipt in case they want to exchange it?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 선택이에요. 교환하고 싶을 수 있으니 선물 영수증을 넣어 드릴까요?
questions.sample: Yes, that's thoughtful. And please wrap it in white paper.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 배려 깊네요. 그리고 흰색 포장지로 싸 주세요.

closing: Certainly. I'm sure the couple will appreciate it.
closing_ko: 그럼요. 두 분이 분명 고마워하실 거예요.

title: Second-Hand Shopping
situation_ko: 중고 가게에서 물건을 사며 중고 거래에 대한 생각을 나눠요.
ai_role: An owner of a second-hand shop
user_role: A shopper who likes buying used items

key_phrases.text: I like finding unique things at a good price.
key_phrases.ko: 좋은 가격에 특별한 물건을 찾는 게 좋아요.

key_phrases.text: I just check the condition carefully.

questions.q: Welcome to the shop! Have you shopped second-hand before?
questions.q_ko: 어서 오세요! 중고 물건을 사 본 적 있으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, quite often. I like finding unique things at a good price.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 꽤 자주요. 좋은 가격에 특별한 물건을 찾는 게 좋아요.

questions.q: That's great. What do you usually buy?
questions.sample: Mostly books, furniture, and sometimes clothes.
questions.sample_ko: 주로 책이랑 가구, 가끔 옷도 사요.

questions.q: Some people worry about the quality of used items. How do you feel about that?
questions.q_ko: 어떤 사람들은 중고품의 품질을 걱정해요. 어떻게 생각하세요?
questions.sample: I don't worry much. I just check the condition carefully before buying.
questions.sample_ko: 크게 걱정하지 않아요. 사기 전에 상태를 꼼꼼히 확인하기만 해요.

questions.q: Smart approach. Do you think second-hand shopping is becoming more popular?
questions.q_ko: 현명한 방법이에요. 중고 쇼핑이 더 인기를 얻고 있다고 생각하세요?
questions.sample: Yes, I think so. People care more about saving money and about the environment.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 그런 것 같아요. 사람들이 절약과 환경에 더 신경 쓰니까요.

questions.q: Exactly. Is there something specific you're hoping to find today?
questions.q_ko: 맞아요. 오늘 특별히 찾고 싶은 게 있으세요?
questions.sample: A small wooden desk, if you have one, for my study.
questions.sample_ko: 서재에 놓을 작은 나무 책상이 있다면요.

closing: We just got one in yesterday. Let me show you!
closing_ko: 어제 막 들어온 게 있어요. 보여 드릴게요!

title: Internet Outage Compensation
situation_ko: 며칠간 인터넷이 끊겨서 요금 보상을 요청해요.

key_phrases.text: My internet has been down for three days.
I work from home, so this has really affected me.
I'd like a discount on my bill.

questions.q: Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
questions.sample: My internet has been down for three days, and no one has fixed it yet.
questions.sample_ko: 인터넷이 사흘째 끊겨 있는데 아직 아무도 고쳐 주지 않았어요.

questions.q: I'm very sorry. Did you report it earlier?
questions.sample: Yes, I called on Monday and they said a technician would come, but nobody did.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 월요일에 전화했더니 기사님이 오신다고 했는데 아무도 안 왔어요.

questions.q: I apologize for that. How has the outage affected you?
questions.q_ko: 그 점 사과드립니다. 장애로 어떤 영향을 받으셨나요?
questions.sample: I work from home, so it has really affected me. I had to work from a cafe.
questions.sample_ko: 재택근무라 정말 지장이 컸어요. 카페에서 일해야 했어요.

questions.q: That must have been frustrating. We can send a technician tomorrow morning. Is that acceptable?
questions.q_ko: 많이 답답하셨겠어요. 내일 오전에 기사님을 보내 드릴 수 있어요. 괜찮으세요?
questions.sample: Yes, but I'd like someone to call me beforehand, and I'd like a discount on my bill too.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 하지만 오기 전에 전화를 주셨으면 하고 요금도 할인받고 싶어요.

questions.q: We can credit you for the three days. Is there anything else I can do to make this right?
questions.q_ko: 3일치를 크레딧으로 드릴 수 있어요. 그 밖에 보상해 드릴 방법이 더 있을까요?
questions.sample: If it happens again, I'd like to be able to cancel the contract without a fee.
questions.sample_ko: 또 이런 일이 생기면 위약금 없이 계약을 해지할 수 있었으면 해요.

closing: I've noted that on your account. Thank you for your patience, and we'll fix this tomorrow.
closing_ko: 고객님 계정에 기록해 두었어요. 기다려 주셔서 감사하고 내일 해결해 드릴게요.

title: First Day Hello
situation_ko: 첫 출근 날 로비에서 안내 직원을 만났어요.
user_role: A new employee on the first day

questions.q: Good morning! What's your name?
questions.sample: My name is Jin.

questions.q: Nice to meet you! Is today your first day?
questions.sample: Yes, it's my first day.

questions.q: Great! Which team are you on?
questions.sample: I'm on the sales team.

questions.q: Oh, nice. Are you nervous?
questions.sample: Yes, a little.

questions.q: Don't worry. Do you want some coffee or tea?
questions.sample: Coffee, please.

closing: Welcome to the team! I hope you have a great first day.
closing_ko: 팀에 오신 걸 환영해요! 첫날 잘 보내길 바라요.

title: Meet a Colleague
situation_ko: 옆자리 동료가 말을 걸어 왔어요.
ai_role: A coworker sitting next to you

questions.q: Hi! I'm Mina. What's your name?
questions.sample: I'm Tom. Nice to meet you.

questions.q: Nice to meet you, too! Are you new here?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm new here.

questions.q: Welcome! Where do you live?
questions.sample: I live in Seoul.

questions.q: Oh, that's close! Do you come to work by bus?
questions.sample: No, I take the subway.

questions.q: I see. Do you like your new desk?
questions.sample: Yes, it's nice.

closing: If you need help, just ask me. I'm right here!
closing_ko: 도움이 필요하면 말해요. 바로 옆에 있어요!

title: Coffee Break
situation_ko: 휴게실에서 동료와 커피를 마시고 있어요.
user_role: An office worker on a break

questions.q: Hi! Do you want some coffee?
questions.sample: Yes, please.

questions.q: Sure! Do you like it with milk?
questions.sample: Yes, I like it with milk.

questions.q: Okay! How many cups of coffee do you drink a day?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요! 하루에 커피를 몇 잔 마셔요?
questions.sample: Two cups a day.

questions.q: Wow, me too! Is your work busy today?
questions.sample: Yes, very busy.

questions.q: Oh no. What do you do after work?
questions.sample: I go home and rest.

closing: Thanks for the chat. Good luck with your work!
closing_ko: 이야기해서 좋았어요. 일 잘하세요!

title: Your Job
situation_ko: 모임에서 처음 만난 사람이 직업을 물어봐요.
ai_role: A friendly person you just met

key_phrases.text: I work at a small company.

questions.q: Hello! What do you do?
questions.sample: I'm a designer.

questions.q: Cool! Where do you work?
questions.sample: I work at a small company.

questions.q: I see. Do you like your job?
questions.sample: Yes, I like my job.

questions.q: That's great! Do you work every day?
questions.sample: I work Monday to Friday.

questions.q: Okay. What time do you start work?
questions.sample: I start at nine.

closing: It was nice to hear about your job. Have a good day!
closing_ko: 당신의 일 이야기를 들어서 좋았어요. 좋은 하루 보내요!

title: Where Is the Restroom
situation_ko: 새 사무실에서 화장실과 회의실 위치를 물어봐요.

questions.q: Hi! Do you need help?
questions.sample: Yes, where is the restroom?

questions.q: It's down the hall, on the left. Do you also need the meeting room?
questions.q_ko: 복도 끝 왼쪽에 있어요. 회의실도 필요해요?
questions.sample: Yes, where is it?

questions.q: It's next to the kitchen. Do you know where the kitchen is?
questions.sample: No, I don't.

questions.q: No problem! It's near the stairs. Is the office big for you?
questions.q_ko: 괜찮아요! 계단 근처예요. 사무실이 크게 느껴져요?
questions.sample: Yes, it's very big.

questions.q: You'll learn it soon. Do you want me to show you around?
questions.q_ko: 곧 익숙해질 거예요. 제가 안내해 줄까요?
questions.sample: Yes, please.

closing: Let's go. Follow me!
closing_ko: 가요. 따라오세요!

title: Lunch Time
situation_ko: 점심시간에 동료가 같이 먹자고 해요.

questions.q: It's lunch time! Are you hungry?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm hungry.

questions.q: Me too! What do you want to eat?
questions.sample: I want noodles.

questions.q: Good idea! Do you like spicy food?
questions.sample: Yes, I like it.

questions.q: Great. Do you bring lunch from home?
questions.sample: No, I eat out.

questions.q: I see. How long is your lunch break?
questions.sample: One hour.

closing: Okay, let's go eat. I'm hungry now!
closing_ko: 좋아요, 먹으러 가요. 이제 저도 배고파요!

title: Work Hours
situation_ko: 동료가 근무 시간에 대해 물어봐요.

questions.q: Hi! What time do you start work?
questions.sample: I start at nine.

questions.q: Oh, early! What time do you finish?
questions.sample: I finish at six.

questions.q: That's a long day. Are you tired now?
questions.sample: Yes, a little tired.

questions.q: Me too. Do you work on Saturday?
questions.sample: No, I don't.

questions.q: Lucky you! What do you do on weekends?
questions.sample: I sleep and watch TV.

closing: Rest well this weekend. See you on Monday!
closing_ko: 이번 주말 잘 쉬어요. 월요일에 봐요!

title: Commute to Work
situation_ko: 엘리베이터에서 동료가 출근길에 대해 물어봐요.

questions.q: Good morning! How do you come to work?
questions.sample: I take the subway.

questions.q: Me too! How long does it take?
questions.sample: About 40 minutes.

questions.q: That's not bad. Is the subway crowded?
questions.sample: Yes, it's very crowded.

questions.q: I know! What do you do on the subway?
questions.sample: I listen to music.

questions.q: Nice. Do you have breakfast before work?
questions.sample: No, I don't have time.

closing: Here's our floor. Have a good day!
closing_ko: 우리 층이에요. 좋은 하루 보내요!

title: Borrow a Pen
situation_ko: 회의 전에 동료에게 펜을 빌려요.

questions.q: Hi! You look worried. What do you need?
questions.sample: Can I borrow a pen?

questions.q: Sure, here you go. Do you need paper, too?
questions.sample: Yes, please.

questions.q: Okay. Do you have a meeting now?
questions.sample: Yes, at ten o'clock.

questions.q: I see. Which room is it in?
questions.sample: Room 3.

questions.q: That's near here. Do you want some water for the meeting?
questions.sample: Yes, thank you.

closing: Good luck in your meeting. You can keep the pen!
closing_ko: 회의 잘하세요. 펜은 가져도 돼요!

title: Your Desk
situation_ko: 동료가 당신의 책상을 보고 이야기해요.

questions.q: Is this your desk?
questions.sample: Yes, this is my desk.

questions.q: It's nice! Who is in the photo?
questions.sample: It's my family.

questions.q: How nice! Do you have a plant?
questions.sample: Yes, a small plant.

questions.q: Cute. Is your computer new?
questions.sample: Yes, it's new.

questions.q: Good. Do you like your seat by the window?
questions.sample: Yes, I like the light.

closing: You have a very nice desk. Thanks for showing me!
closing_ko: 책상이 정말 멋져요. 보여 줘서 고마워요!

title: Answering the Phone
situation_ko: 회사 전화를 받았는데 누가 팀장님을 찾아요.
ai_role: A caller looking for the manager
user_role: An office worker answering the phone

questions.q: Hello? Who is this?
questions.sample: Hello, this is Jin.

questions.q: Hi Jin. Is Mr. Park there?
questions.sample: No, he is not here.

questions.q: Oh. When will he be back?
questions.sample: At two o'clock.

questions.q: I see. Can I leave a message?
questions.sample: Yes, please.

questions.q: Please tell him Anna called. Can you do that?
questions.q_ko: 애나가 전화했다고 전해 주세요. 그렇게 해 줄 수 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, no problem.

closing: Thank you so much. Have a nice day!
closing_ko: 정말 고마워요. 좋은 하루 보내세요!

title: Office Supplies
situation_ko: 필요한 사무용품을 총무 담당자에게 말해요.

questions.q: Hello! What do you need?
questions.sample: I need a notebook.

questions.q: Okay. How many do you need?
questions.sample: Two, please.

questions.q: Sure. Do you need pens, too?
questions.sample: Yes, three pens.

questions.q: No problem. What color pens do you like?
questions.sample: Blue, please.

questions.q: Okay. Can you come back at three?
questions.sample: Yes, I can.

closing: Great, I'll have everything ready for you. See you at three!
closing_ko: 좋아요, 다 준비해 둘게요. 3시에 봐요!

title: Saying Goodbye
situation_ko: 퇴근 시간에 동료와 인사를 나눠요.

questions.q: It's six o'clock! Are you going home?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm going home.

questions.q: Lucky! How was your day?
questions.sample: It was good.

questions.q: Nice. What are you going to do tonight?
questions.q_ko: 좋네요. 오늘 밤에 뭐 할 거예요?
questions.sample: I'm going to cook dinner.

questions.q: Sounds good. Do you go home by bus?
questions.sample: No, by subway.

questions.q: Okay. Are you coming to work tomorrow?
questions.sample: Yes, of course.

closing: Great! See you tomorrow. Have a good evening!
closing_ko: 좋아요! 내일 봐요. 좋은 저녁 보내요!

title: Your Boss
situation_ko: 동료가 당신의 상사에 대해 가볍게 물어봐요.

questions.q: Tell me about your work. Is your boss nice?
questions.q_ko: 일 이야기 해 줘요. 팀장님은 좋은 분이에요?
questions.sample: Yes, my boss is kind.

questions.q: That's good! Is your boss a man or a woman?
questions.sample: She is a woman.

questions.q: I see. Is she busy?
questions.sample: Yes, she is very busy.

questions.q: Oh. How many coworkers do you have?
questions.sample: I have five coworkers.

questions.q: Nice team! Do you eat lunch together?
questions.sample: Yes, every day.

closing: It sounds like a great team. I'm happy for you!
closing_ko: 좋은 팀 같아요. 잘됐네요!

title: Friday Plans
situation_ko: 금요일 오후에 동료가 주말 계획을 물어봐요.

questions.q: It's Friday! Are you happy?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm very happy.

questions.q: Me too! What are you going to do this weekend?
questions.q_ko: 저도요! 이번 주말에 뭐 할 거예요?
questions.sample: I'm going to rest at home.

questions.q: That sounds nice. Do you want to meet a friend?
questions.sample: Yes, on Sunday.

questions.q: Fun! Where will you meet?
questions.sample: At a cafe.

questions.q: Great. What do you like to do on weekends?
questions.q_ko: 좋네요. 주말에 뭐 하는 걸 좋아해요?
questions.sample: I like to go for a walk.

closing: Have a lovely weekend! See you on Monday.
closing_ko: 즐거운 주말 보내요! 월요일에 봐요.

title: Introducing Yourself to the Team
situation_ko: 입사 후 첫 팀 회의에서 자기소개를 해요.

key_phrases.text: I used to work at a bank.
I'm looking forward to working with you.
In my free time, I like to hike.

questions.q: Welcome to the team! Could you tell us a little about yourself?
questions.q_ko: 팀에 온 걸 환영해요! 자기소개를 조금 해 줄래요?
questions.sample: Sure. My name is Jin, and I'm from Busan.
questions.sample_ko: 네. 제 이름은 진이고 부산 출신이에요.

questions.q: Nice to meet you, Jin! Where did you work before this?
questions.sample: I used to work at a bank for three years.

questions.q: Interesting! Why did you decide to change jobs?
questions.sample: I wanted to try something more creative.
questions.sample_ko: 좀 더 창의적인 일을 해 보고 싶었어요.

questions.q: That makes sense. What do you like to do in your free time?
questions.q_ko: 이해가 가요. 여가 시간에는 뭘 하는 걸 좋아해요?
questions.sample: I like to hike on weekends.

questions.q: Great! Is there anything you hope to learn here?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요! 여기서 배우고 싶은 게 있나요?
questions.sample: I hope to learn how the marketing team works.

closing: Thanks, Jin. We're happy to have you with us!
closing_ko: 고마워요, 진. 함께하게 되어 기뻐요!

title: Explaining Your Job
situation_ko: 다른 부서 사람이 당신이 하는 일을 궁금해해요.
ai_role: A curious coworker from another department

key_phrases.text: I'm in charge of customer emails.
Most of my day is spent on...

questions.q: I've seen you around, but what exactly do you do here?
questions.q_ko: 자주 봤는데, 여기서 정확히 무슨 일을 해요?
questions.sample: I'm in charge of customer emails and questions.

questions.q: Oh, that sounds busy! How many emails do you answer each day?
questions.q_ko: 아, 바쁘겠어요! 하루에 이메일을 몇 통 답해요?
questions.sample: About fifty, but it changes every day.

questions.q: Wow. What's the hardest part of your job?
questions.q_ko: 와. 일에서 가장 어려운 부분이 뭐예요?
questions.sample: Talking to angry customers is hard.

questions.q: I can imagine. And what do you enjoy most?
questions.q_ko: 상상이 가요. 그럼 가장 좋은 점은요?
questions.sample: I enjoy it when a customer says thank you.

questions.q: That's lovely. Who do you work with most closely?
questions.sample: I work with the sales team a lot.

closing: Thanks for explaining. Now I understand your work much better!
closing_ko: 설명해 줘서 고마워요. 이제 당신 일을 훨씬 잘 알겠어요!

title: Weekly Update
situation_ko: 월요일 아침에 팀장에게 지난주 일을 보고해요.
user_role: A team member giving an update

key_phrases.text: Last week, I finished the report.

questions.q: Good morning! How did last week go?
questions.sample: It went well. I finished the monthly report.

questions.q: Great! Is there anything you're still working on?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요! 아직 작업 중인 게 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm still working on the new price list.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 새 가격표를 아직 작업 중이에요.

questions.q: Okay. When do you think it will be ready?
questions.sample: I think I can send it by Wednesday.
questions.sample_ko: 수요일까지 보낼 수 있을 것 같아요.

questions.q: Perfect. Did you have any problems last week?
questions.sample: Only one. The file was too big to send.
questions.sample_ko: 하나 있었어요. 파일이 너무 커서 보낼 수 없었어요.

questions.q: I see. What's your main goal for this week?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 이번 주 주요 목표는 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I want to finish the price list and start the next project.
questions.sample_ko: 가격표를 끝내고 다음 프로젝트를 시작하고 싶어요.

closing: Thanks for the update. Let me know if you need anything.
closing_ko: 보고 고마워요. 필요한 게 있으면 말해 줘요.

title: Asking for Help
situation_ko: 어려운 작업이 있어서 선배에게 도움을 청해요.

key_phrases.ko: 어떻게 하는지 보여 줄 수 있어요?

questions.q: Hey, you look a bit stuck. What's going on?
questions.q_ko: 저기, 좀 막힌 것 같아 보여요. 무슨 일이에요?
questions.sample: Do you have a minute? I need some help with a spreadsheet.
questions.sample_ko: 잠깐 시간 있어요? 스프레드시트 때문에 도움이 필요해요.

questions.q: Sure. Which part is the problem?
questions.sample: I'm stuck on the formula in this column.

questions.q: Let me look. Have you tried it a different way?
questions.sample: Yes, but the numbers are still wrong.

questions.q: I see the mistake. Do you want me to show you how to fix it?
questions.q_ko: 실수를 찾았어요. 고치는 방법을 보여 줄까요?
questions.sample: Yes, please. Could you go slowly?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 부탁해요. 천천히 해 줄 수 있어요?

questions.q: Of course. Will you be able to do it by yourself next time?
questions.q_ko: 물론이죠. 다음엔 혼자 할 수 있겠어요?
questions.sample: I think so. I'll take notes.

closing: Anytime! Don't be shy about asking for help.
closing_ko: 언제든지요! 도움 요청하는 걸 부끄러워하지 마요.

title: Deadline Check
situation_ko: 프로젝트 마감이 다가와서 팀장이 진행 상황을 물어요.

questions.q: Hi! The deadline is on Friday. How is the project going?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 마감이 금요일이에요. 프로젝트는 어떻게 되어 가요?
questions.sample: I'm almost done. I just need to check a few things.
questions.sample_ko: 거의 다 했어요. 몇 가지만 확인하면 돼요.

questions.q: Good to hear. Is anything slowing you down?
questions.sample: I'm waiting for some numbers from finance.

questions.q: Okay, I'll ask them. Do you think you'll finish on time?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요, 제가 물어볼게요. 제시간에 끝낼 수 있을 것 같아요?
questions.sample: I think so, but I might need one more day.
questions.sample_ko: 그럴 것 같지만 하루가 더 필요할 수도 있어요.

questions.q: I see. What would help you the most right now?
questions.q_ko: 그렇군요. 지금 가장 도움이 되는 게 뭘까요?
questions.sample: It would help if someone could check my slides.
questions.sample_ko: 누가 제 슬라이드를 확인해 주면 도움이 될 거예요.

questions.q: I'll ask Sora. How do you usually manage a tight deadline?
questions.q_ko: 소라에게 부탁할게요. 촉박한 마감은 보통 어떻게 관리해요?
questions.sample: I make a list and finish the important things first.

closing: Thanks. Keep me posted and don't stress too much!
closing_ko: 고마워요. 계속 알려 주고, 너무 스트레스 받지 마요!

title: Starting a Meeting
situation_ko: 팀 회의에 참석해서 안건과 의견을 이야기해요.

questions.q: Okay, everyone, let's start. Did you get the meeting agenda?
questions.q_ko: 자, 여러분 시작할게요. 회의 안건 받았어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I got it this morning.

questions.q: Good. The first topic is the new schedule. What do you think?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 첫 안건은 새 일정이에요. 어떻게 생각해요?
questions.sample: I think it's good, but it's a little tight.

questions.q: Fair point. Do you have any ideas to make it easier?
questions.q_ko: 맞는 말이에요. 더 쉽게 만들 아이디어가 있어요?
questions.sample: Maybe we can start the work a week earlier.
questions.sample_ko: 일을 일주일 일찍 시작하면 될 것 같아요.

questions.q: Hmm, that might work. Is there anything unclear so far?
questions.q_ko: 음, 가능할 것 같아요. 지금까지 불분명한 게 있어요?
questions.sample: Could you repeat the last part, please?

questions.q: Sure. Do you want to take notes for the team today?
questions.q_ko: 물론이죠. 오늘 팀을 위해 회의록을 써 줄래요?
questions.sample: Okay, I can do that.

closing: Thank you, everyone. Let's meet again next Tuesday.
closing_ko: 모두 고마워요. 다음 주 화요일에 다시 만나요.

title: Video Call Trouble
situation_ko: 화상 회의 중에 소리가 안 들려서 상황을 설명해요.
ai_role: A colleague on a video call
user_role: A participant on a video call

questions.q: Hello? Can you hear me?
questions.sample: I can't hear you very well. It's quiet.

questions.q: Oh, sorry. Is this better?
questions.sample: Yes, now I can hear you.

questions.q: Great. Now, can you share your screen?
questions.sample: Sure. Can you see my screen now?

questions.q: Not yet. What do you think the problem is?
questions.sample: Maybe my internet is slow. Let me try again.
questions.sample_ko: 인터넷이 느린가 봐요. 다시 해 볼게요.

questions.q: Okay. If it doesn't work, what should we do?
questions.sample: I can send you the file by email.
questions.sample_ko: 파일을 이메일로 보내 드릴 수 있어요.

closing: Thanks for your patience. Technology can be tricky sometimes!
closing_ko: 기다려 줘서 고마워요. 기술은 가끔 까다로워요!

title: Giving Feedback
situation_ko: 동료가 만든 발표 자료에 대해 의견을 말해 줘요.
ai_role: A coworker who made a presentation

key_phrases.text: It was a bit too long.

questions.q: I just finished my presentation draft. What did you think?
questions.q_ko: 발표 초안을 막 끝냈어요. 어떻게 생각해요?
questions.sample: I really liked the pictures. They were clear.

questions.q: Thank you! Was there anything that was hard to understand?
questions.sample: The third slide had too much text.
questions.sample_ko: 세 번째 슬라이드에 글이 너무 많았어요.

questions.q: Good point. How could I make it better?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 어떻게 하면 더 나아질까요?
questions.sample: Maybe you could use fewer words and a bigger picture.
questions.sample_ko: 글을 줄이고 사진을 크게 해 보면 어떨까요.

questions.q: I'll try that. How was the length?
questions.sample: It was a bit too long. Ten minutes is enough.

questions.q: Okay. Would you like to see it again after I change it?
questions.sample: Sure, send it to me tomorrow.

closing: Your feedback is really helpful. Thank you!
closing_ko: 피드백이 정말 도움이 돼요. 고마워요!

title: Asking for a Day Off
situation_ko: 다음 주에 하루 쉬고 싶어서 팀장에게 말해요.

key_phrases.text: Can I take a day off?
I'll finish my work before I go.

questions.q: Hi, you wanted to talk to me?
questions.sample: Yes. Can I take a day off next week?
questions.sample_ko: 네. 다음 주에 하루 쉬어도 될까요?

questions.q: Which day do you want?
questions.sample: Next Thursday, if that's okay.

questions.q: I see. Is there a special reason?
questions.sample: Yes, I have a family event.

questions.q: That's fine. What about your work that day?
questions.sample: I'll finish everything before I go.

questions.q: Good. Can someone help with your tasks if something comes up?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 일이 생기면 누가 대신 도와줄 수 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, Mina said she can help me.
questions.sample_ko: 네, 미나가 도와줄 수 있다고 했어요.

closing: Okay, it's approved. Enjoy your day off!
closing_ko: 좋아요, 승인할게요. 쉬는 날 즐겁게 보내요!

title: Working Overtime
situation_ko: 일이 많아서 늦게까지 남아 일하고 있어요.

key_phrases.text: I'm trying to finish this today.

questions.q: You're still here! Why are you working so late?
questions.q_ko: 아직 있네요! 왜 이렇게 늦게까지 일해요?
questions.sample: I have to finish a report for tomorrow morning.

questions.q: Oh no. How long have you been here today?
questions.sample: Since eight this morning. I'm exhausted.

questions.q: That's a long day. Have you had dinner yet?
questions.sample: Not yet. I ate a snack at my desk.

questions.q: Let's order something. What do you feel like eating?
questions.sample: Maybe chicken or pizza. Anything is fine.

questions.q: Okay. How often do you have to work overtime?
questions.sample: Maybe once or twice a month.

closing: Hang in there. You're almost done!
closing_ko: 힘내요. 거의 다 했어요!

title: Business Trip Plan
situation_ko: 다음 달 해외 출장을 앞두고 준비 사항을 이야기해요.
user_role: An employee going on a business trip

key_phrases.text: I'll be there for three days.
Could you book a hotel near the office?

questions.q: I heard you have a business trip next month. Where are you going?
questions.q_ko: 다음 달에 출장이 있다고 들었어요. 어디로 가요?
questions.sample: I'm going to Singapore to meet a client.

questions.q: Nice! How many days will you stay?
questions.sample: I'll be there for three days.

questions.q: Okay. Do you prefer a window or an aisle seat on the plane?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 비행기에서 창가와 복도 중 어떤 좌석이 좋아요?
questions.sample: I prefer a window seat.

questions.q: Noted. What kind of hotel would you like?
questions.sample: Something simple and close to the client's office.

questions.q: Got it. Is there anything you need to prepare before you go?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 가기 전에 준비할 게 있어요?
questions.sample: I need to finish my presentation and check my passport.
questions.sample_ko: 발표 자료를 끝내고 여권을 확인해야 해요.

closing: I'll send you all the details by email. Have a safe trip!
closing_ko: 자세한 내용은 이메일로 보낼게요. 안전한 출장 되세요!

title: Onboarding Day
situation_ko: 입사 첫 주에 인사 담당자와 오리엔테이션을 해요.

key_phrases.text: When do I get my ID card?

questions.q: Welcome! How is your first week going?
questions.sample: It's going well, but there's a lot to learn.
questions.sample_ko: 잘 지나가고 있는데 배울 게 많아요.

questions.q: That's normal. Do you have any questions about the company rules?
questions.q_ko: 그건 당연해요. 회사 규칙에 대해 질문 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, I have a question about working from home.

questions.q: You can work from home twice a week. Is that okay for you?
questions.q_ko: 일주일에 두 번 재택근무를 할 수 있어요. 괜찮아요?
questions.sample: That's great. When do I get my ID card?

questions.q: You'll get it tomorrow. Have you met your mentor yet?
questions.sample: Yes, we had lunch together on Monday.

questions.q: Wonderful. What has been the most helpful so far?
questions.q_ko: 잘됐네요. 지금까지 가장 도움이 된 게 뭐예요?
questions.sample: The welcome guide was very helpful.

closing: If you need anything else, my door is always open.
closing_ko: 다른 게 필요하면 언제든 찾아와요.

title: Team Lunch Order
situation_ko: 팀 점심으로 무엇을 먹을지 정하고 있어요.

questions.q: We're ordering lunch for the team. What are you in the mood for?
questions.q_ko: 팀 점심을 주문하는 중이에요. 뭐가 당겨요?
questions.sample: I'm in the mood for Korean food, like bibimbap.

questions.q: Sounds good. Do you have any food allergies?
questions.sample: Yes, I'm allergic to peanuts.

questions.q: Thanks for telling me. Do you want something to drink?
questions.q_ko: 말해 줘서 고마워요. 마실 것도 필요해요?
questions.sample: Just water, please.

questions.q: Okay. Do you want to pay by yourself, or should we split the bill?
questions.sample: Let's split the bill. It's easier.

questions.q: Good idea. Where should we eat, in the office or outside?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 사무실에서 먹을까요, 밖에서 먹을까요?
questions.sample: Let's eat outside. The weather is nice.

closing: Perfect! I'll make the order. Lunch will be fun.
closing_ko: 좋아요! 제가 주문할게요. 즐거운 점심이 될 거예요.

title: Working from Home Day
situation_ko: 재택근무 날 화상으로 팀원과 근황을 나눠요.
ai_role: A teammate on a video chat

key_phrases.text: I'm working from my living room.

questions.q: Hi! Where are you working from today?
questions.sample: I'm working from my living room.

questions.q: Nice! Do you like working from home?
questions.sample: Yes, it's easier to focus here.

questions.q: I feel the same. Do you start earlier or later than usual?
questions.q_ko: 저도 그래요. 평소보다 일찍 시작해요, 늦게 시작해요?
questions.sample: I start a little later because I don't have to commute.

questions.q: Makes sense. Is there anything you don't like about it?
questions.sample: I miss chatting with everyone.

questions.q: Me too! What do you do for lunch at home?
questions.q_ko: 저도요! 집에서는 점심을 뭐 해 먹어요?
questions.sample: I usually cook something simple, like fried rice.
questions.sample_ko: 보통 볶음밥처럼 간단한 걸 해 먹어요.

closing: Thanks for the chat. Talk to you later on the call!
closing_ko: 이야기해서 좋았어요. 이따 회의에서 봐요!

title: Scheduling a Meeting
situation_ko: 다른 팀과 회의 시간을 정하고 있어요.

questions.q: Hi! I heard you want to set up a meeting. What is it about?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요! 회의를 잡고 싶다고 들었어요. 무슨 내용이에요?
questions.sample: It's about the new product launch.

questions.q: I see. How long do you think we'll need?
questions.sample: Probably about an hour.

questions.q: Okay. I'm busy on Monday. When are you free?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 월요일은 바빠요. 언제 시간 돼요?
questions.sample: How about Tuesday at two?

questions.q: That works for me. Should we meet in person or online?
questions.q_ko: 저는 괜찮아요. 직접 만날까요, 온라인으로 할까요?
questions.sample: Let's meet online. It's easier for everyone.

questions.q: Sounds good. Who else should we invite?
questions.sample: Let's invite Sora from design and Dan from sales.

closing: Great, I'll send the invitation now. See you on Tuesday!
closing_ko: 좋아요, 지금 초대장을 보낼게요. 화요일에 봐요!

title: Email Follow-up
situation_ko: 보낸 이메일에 답이 없어서 동료에게 확인해요.
ai_role: A coworker who received your email

questions.q: Hi! What can I do for you?
questions.sample: Did you get my email from yesterday?

questions.q: Oh, sorry, I haven't read it yet. What was it about?
questions.q_ko: 아, 미안해요, 아직 못 읽었어요. 무슨 내용이었어요?
questions.sample: I asked for the sales numbers for last month.

questions.q: Ah, I remember. When do you need them?
questions.sample: No rush, but by Thursday would be great.

questions.q: I can do that. In what format would you like them?
questions.q_ko: 할 수 있어요. 어떤 형식으로 원해요?
questions.sample: An Excel file is fine.

questions.q: Okay. Should I send it only to you, or to the whole team?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 당신에게만 보낼까요, 팀 전체에 보낼까요?
questions.sample: Please send it to the whole team.

closing: Got it. I'll send it today. Thanks for reminding me!
closing_ko: 알겠어요. 오늘 보낼게요. 알려 줘서 고마워요!

title: Telling Your Manager You're Sick
situation_ko: 몸이 안 좋아서 아침에 팀장에게 전화해요.

key_phrases.text: I think I have a fever.

questions.q: Hello? Is everything okay?
questions.sample: Not really. I'm not feeling well today.

questions.q: I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong?
questions.sample: I think I have a fever and a bad headache.
questions.sample_ko: 열이 있고 머리가 많이 아픈 것 같아요.

questions.q: You should rest. Are you going to see a doctor?
questions.sample: Yes, I have an appointment this afternoon.

questions.q: Good. Is there anything urgent at work today?
questions.sample: Just one email. I'll ask Mina to send it.
questions.sample_ko: 이메일 하나뿐이에요. 미나에게 보내 달라고 할게요.

questions.q: Okay. When do you think you'll be back?
questions.q_ko: 알겠어요. 언제 돌아올 수 있을 것 같아요?
questions.sample: I'll be back on Wednesday if I feel better.

closing: Take care and get well soon. Don't worry about work.
closing_ko: 몸조리 잘하고 빨리 나아요. 일은 걱정 말아요.

title: Office Small Talk
situation_ko: 복사기 앞에서 동료와 가벼운 대화를 나눠요.

key_phrases.text: I can't believe it's already October.

questions.q: Hey! How was your weekend?
questions.sample: It was great. I went hiking with friends.

questions.q: That sounds fun! Where did you go?
questions.sample: We went to Bukhansan. The leaves were beautiful.

questions.q: Lovely. Do you hike a lot?
questions.sample: About once a month.

questions.q: Nice. I can't believe it's already October! Do you have any plans for the holidays?
questions.sample: I'm going to visit my parents in Daegu.
questions.sample_ko: 대구에 계신 부모님을 뵈러 갈 거예요.

questions.q: That's sweet. How do you usually get there?
questions.sample: I take the KTX. It's fast.

closing: Well, back to work! Enjoy the rest of your day.
closing_ko: 자, 다시 일해야겠네요! 남은 하루 잘 보내요.

title: Welcoming a New Teammate
situation_ko: 새로 온 팀원에게 사무실을 소개하고 팁을 줘요.

key_phrases.text: My advice is to ask questions.
The best coffee is on the second floor.

questions.q: Hi, I'm new here and a little lost. Could you help me?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요, 저는 새로 왔는데 좀 헤매고 있어요. 도와줄 수 있어요?
questions.sample: Of course! Let me show you around.

questions.q: Thank you! Where can I get a good cup of coffee?
questions.q_ko: 고마워요! 맛있는 커피는 어디서 마실 수 있어요?
questions.sample: The best coffee is on the second floor.

questions.q: Perfect! Do you have any advice for a new person?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요! 신입에게 해 줄 조언이 있어요?
questions.sample: Don't be afraid to ask questions. Everyone is friendly.
questions.sample_ko: 질문하는 걸 두려워하지 마요. 다들 친절해요.

questions.q: That's reassuring. How long have you worked here?
questions.sample: About four years now.

questions.q: Four years! What do you like most about this place?
questions.sample: I like the people. We help each other a lot.

closing: That makes me feel better. Thanks for your help!
closing_ko: 마음이 놓여요. 도와줘서 고마워요!

title: Printer Problem
situation_ko: 프린터가 고장 나서 IT 담당자에게 도움을 청해요.

key_phrases.text: It says there's a paper jam.
I need it as soon as possible.

questions.q: IT support, how can I help?
questions.sample: The printer on the third floor isn't working.

questions.q: I'm sorry about that. What does the screen say?
questions.q_ko: 불편을 드려 죄송해요. 화면에 뭐라고 나와요?
questions.sample: It says there's a paper jam.

questions.q: Let's try something. Can you open the back door and check for paper?
questions.q_ko: 한번 해 봐요. 뒤쪽 문을 열고 종이가 있는지 확인해 줄래요?
questions.sample: Okay, I see a piece of paper. I'll take it out.

questions.q: Good. Now try printing again. Does it work?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 이제 다시 인쇄해 봐요. 되나요?
questions.sample: Yes, it works now. Thank you!

questions.q: Great. Do you need anything else today?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 오늘 다른 필요한 건 있어요?
questions.sample: Yes, my computer is a little slow. Can you check it later?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 컴퓨터가 좀 느려요. 나중에 봐 줄 수 있어요?

closing: Sure, I'll stop by this afternoon. Have a good day!
closing_ko: 그럼요, 오후에 들를게요. 좋은 하루 보내요!

title: Job Interview Strengths
situation_ko: 면접에서 자신의 강점과 약점을 설명해요.

questions.q: Thank you for coming in. Why are you interested in this position?
questions.q_ko: 와 줘서 고마워요. 이 자리에 관심을 가진 이유가 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I've admired your company for years, and this role matches my skills in project planning.
questions.sample_ko: 몇 년째 회사를 존경해 왔고, 이 역할이 제 기획 능력과 잘 맞아요.

questions.q: Good. What would you say is your greatest strength?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 가장 큰 강점이 뭐라고 생각해요?
questions.sample: I'm good at staying calm under pressure and organizing a team.
questions.sample_ko: 압박 속에서 침착함을 유지하고 팀을 조직하는 걸 잘해요.

questions.q: Can you give me an example?
questions.q_ko: 예를 하나 들어 줄 수 있어요?
questions.sample: For example, last year our deadline moved up, and I made a new plan so we finished on time.
questions.sample_ko: 예를 들어 작년에 마감이 앞당겨졌는데, 새 계획을 세워서 제시간에 끝냈어요.

questions.q: Impressive. And what is something you're still working on improving?
questions.q_ko: 인상적이네요. 아직 개선하려고 노력 중인 점은 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I sometimes take on too much work, so I'm learning to say no politely.
questions.sample_ko: 가끔 일을 너무 많이 맡아서 정중하게 거절하는 법을 배우고 있어요.

questions.q: Honest answer. Do you have any questions for us?
questions.sample: Yes, what does a typical day look like for this team?
questions.sample_ko: 네, 이 팀의 평범한 하루는 어떤가요?

closing: Thank you. We'll contact you within a week.
closing_ko: 고마워요. 일주일 안에 연락할게요.

title: Networking Event
situation_ko: 업계 행사에서 처음 만난 사람과 명함을 교환하며 대화해요.
ai_role: A professional you meet at an event
user_role: A professional attending a networking event

key_phrases.text: I'd love to keep in touch.
We have a lot in common.

questions.q: Hi, I'm Daniel. What brings you to this event today?
questions.q_ko: 안녕하세요, 대니얼이에요. 오늘 이 행사에 어떻게 오게 됐어요?
questions.sample: I wanted to meet people in the design industry and learn about new trends.
questions.sample_ko: 디자인 업계 사람들을 만나고 새 트렌드를 배우고 싶었어요.

questions.q: Good reason. What kind of work do you do?
questions.sample: I'm a UX designer at a small app company, mostly working on mobile apps.
questions.sample_ko: 작은 앱 회사의 UX 디자이너고, 주로 모바일 앱을 작업해요.

questions.q: Interesting. What do you enjoy most about it, and what's challenging?
questions.q_ko: 흥미롭네요. 가장 즐거운 점과 어려운 점은 뭐예요?
questions.sample: I enjoy solving problems for users, but it's hard to balance their needs with our budget.
questions.sample_ko: 사용자 문제를 푸는 게 즐겁지만 사용자 요구와 예산의 균형을 맞추기 어려워요.

questions.q: I know that feeling. Where do you see the industry going in the next few years?
questions.q_ko: 그 기분 알아요. 앞으로 몇 년간 업계가 어디로 갈 것 같아요?
questions.sample: I think AI tools will change how we work, but human creativity will still matter.
questions.sample_ko: AI 도구가 일하는 방식을 바꾸겠지만 사람의 창의성은 여전히 중요할 거예요.

questions.q: I agree. Would you like to exchange contact details?
questions.sample: Definitely. I'd love to keep in touch and share ideas.
questions.sample_ko: 물론이죠. 계속 연락하고 아이디어를 나누고 싶어요.

closing: Wonderful. It was great meeting you. Let's talk soon!
closing_ko: 좋아요. 만나서 정말 반가웠어요. 곧 이야기해요!

title: Performance Review
situation_ko: 연말 성과 면담에서 한 해를 돌아봐요.

questions.q: Thanks for meeting with me. How do you feel about this past year?
questions.q_ko: 만나 줘서 고마워요. 올해는 어땠다고 생각해요?
questions.sample: Overall, I feel good. I learned a lot and took on more responsibility.
questions.sample_ko: 전반적으로 좋았어요. 많이 배우고 책임도 더 맡았어요.

questions.q: What accomplishment are you most proud of?
questions.sample: I'm proud of leading the website redesign, because it increased our traffic by twenty percent.
questions.sample_ko: 웹사이트 개편을 이끈 게 자랑스러워요. 방문자가 20% 늘었거든요.

questions.q: Great work. Was there anything you found difficult?
questions.sample: Managing my time between several projects was difficult at first.
questions.sample_ko: 처음엔 여러 프로젝트 사이에서 시간 관리가 어려웠어요.

questions.q: I noticed that too. What kind of support would help you next year?
questions.q_ko: 저도 느꼈어요. 내년에 어떤 지원이 도움이 될까요?
questions.sample: I'd like more training in project management.
questions.sample_ko: 프로젝트 관리 교육을 더 받고 싶어요.

questions.q: I can arrange that. One thing I'd suggest is speaking up more in meetings. What do you think?
questions.q_ko: 마련해 볼게요. 제안하자면 회의에서 더 자주 의견을 말해 보세요. 어떻게 생각해요?
questions.sample: That's helpful feedback. I'll try to share my ideas more often.
questions.sample_ko: 도움이 되는 피드백이에요. 아이디어를 더 자주 나누도록 해 볼게요.

closing: Thanks for your honesty. You're doing a great job.
closing_ko: 솔직하게 말해 줘서 고마워요. 정말 잘하고 있어요.

title: Career Goals
situation_ko: 멘토와 앞으로의 커리어 계획을 이야기해요.

key_phrases.text: In five years, I hope to...
I'd like to build my skills in...

questions.q: Let's talk about your future. Where do you see yourself in five years?
questions.q_ko: 미래 이야기를 해 봐요. 5년 뒤 어디에 있을 것 같아요?
questions.sample: In five years, I hope to be a team leader and manage my own projects.
questions.sample_ko: 5년 뒤에는 팀장이 되어 직접 프로젝트를 관리하고 싶어요.

questions.q: That's a good goal. Why does leadership appeal to you?
questions.sample: I enjoy helping others grow, and I like seeing a team succeed together.
questions.sample_ko: 다른 사람이 성장하도록 돕는 게 좋고, 팀이 함께 성공하는 걸 보는 게 좋아요.

questions.q: Which skills do you think you need to develop?
questions.sample: I'd like to build my skills in communication and giving feedback.
questions.sample_ko: 소통과 피드백 주는 능력을 키우고 싶어요.

questions.q: Good. Is there anything that's holding you back right now?
questions.q_ko: 좋아요. 지금 발목을 잡는 게 있어요?
questions.sample: Honestly, I sometimes lack confidence when I speak in English.
questions.sample_ko: 솔직히 영어로 말할 때 가끔 자신감이 부족해요.

questions.q: Many people feel that way. What will you do about it this year?
questions.q_ko: 많은 사람이 그래요. 올해 그걸 위해 뭘 할 거예요?
questions.sample: I plan to practice every day and join an English meeting group.
questions.sample_ko: 매일 연습하고 영어 회의 모임에 참여할 계획이에요.

closing: You have a clear plan. I'm sure you'll get there!
closing_ko: 계획이 뚜렷하네요. 분명 해낼 거예요!

title: Remote vs Office
situation_ko: 재택근무와 사무실 근무 중 어느 쪽이 나은지 의견을 나눠요.

key_phrases.text: The best option might be a mix.
key_phrases.ko: 가장 좋은 건 둘을 섞는 걸 거예요.

questions.q: Our company is talking about work policies. Do you prefer working from home or at the office?
questions.q_ko: 회사에서 근무 방침을 논의 중이에요. 재택과 사무실 중 어느 쪽이 좋아요?
questions.sample: In my opinion, I prefer a mix, because both have advantages.
questions.sample_ko: 제 생각엔 섞는 게 좋아요. 둘 다 장점이 있으니까요.

questions.q: Interesting. What are the advantages of working from home?
questions.sample: You save commuting time and can focus better without interruptions.
questions.sample_ko: 출퇴근 시간을 아끼고 방해 없이 더 집중할 수 있어요.

questions.q: True. On the other hand, what do you like about the office?
questions.sample: On the other hand, it's easier to work together and build relationships in person.
questions.sample_ko: 반면에 직접 만나면 협업하기 쉽고 관계를 쌓기도 좋아요.

questions.q: That's true. Do you think working from home affects productivity?
questions.q_ko: 맞아요. 재택이 생산성에 영향을 준다고 생각해요?
questions.sample: It depends on the person. Some people get distracted at home, but others work better.
questions.sample_ko: 사람에 따라 달라요. 집에서 산만해지는 사람도, 더 잘하는 사람도 있어요.

questions.q: Good point. If you were the boss, what policy would you choose?
questions.q_ko: 좋은 지적이에요. 당신이 사장이라면 어떤 방침을 선택하겠어요?
questions.sample: I'd let people work from home two or three days a week and meet at the office on key days.
questions.sample_ko: 주 2~3일은 재택으로 하고 중요한 날에 사무실에서 만나게 할 거예요.

closing: Interesting ideas. Maybe we should share them with management!
closing_ko: 흥미로운 생각이에요. 경영진에게 전해 보면 좋겠어요!

title: Work-Life Balance
situation_ko: 일과 개인 생활의 균형에 대해 친구와 이야기해요.
ai_role: A friend who works in another company

key_phrases.text: I try to leave on time.
